1star_cuisinartist.name: 1-Star Cuisinartist
1star_cuisinartist.desc: Whipped up 11 meals with an Awesome Pot
1star_cuisinartist.statusText: Now you're cooking! You just earned the title 1-Star Cuisinartist.

2nd_rate_piggy_piggy_hash_slinger.name: 2nd Rate Piggy Hash Slinger
2nd_rate_piggy_piggy_hash_slinger.desc: Fed 23 little Piglets until they grew up into Piggies
2nd_rate_piggy_piggy_hash_slinger.statusText: Your diligence in feeding 23 Piglets until they grew into Piggies has earned you the distinction of being a 2nd Rate Piggy Hash Slinger.

2star_cuisinartist.name: 2-Star Cuisinartist
2star_cuisinartist.desc: Whipped up 23 meals with an Awesome Pot
2star_cuisinartist.statusText: Soup's on! You've moved up in the ranks to 2-Star Cuisinartist.

3rd_rate_piggy_hash_slinger.name: 3rd Rate Piggy Hash Slinger
3rd_rate_piggy_hash_slinger.desc: Fed 3 little Piglets until they grew up into Piggies
3rd_rate_piggy_hash_slinger.statusText: Congratulations on feeding three Piglets until they grew up into Piggies. You are now a 3rd Rate Piggy Hash Slinger. There's a badge and everything.

3star_cuisinartist.name: 3-Star Cuisinartist
3star_cuisinartist.desc: Whipped up 41 meals with an Awesome Pot
3star_cuisinartist.statusText: Don't get in a stew! You've just been promoted to 3-Star Cuisinartist.

4star_cuisinartist.name: 4-Star Cuisinartist
4star_cuisinartist.desc: Whipped up 79 meals with an Awesome Pot
4star_cuisinartist.statusText: Kiss my grits! You've just been promoted to 4-Star Cuisinartist.

5star_cuisinartist.name: 5-Star Cuisinartist
5star_cuisinartist.desc: Whipped up 101 meals with an Awesome Pot
5star_cuisinartist.statusText: It's alimentary! You've earned the title 5-star Cuisinartist.

a1_comrade.name: A-1 Comrade
a1_comrade.statusText: You're a friend in need and a friend in deed. You've earned the title A-1 Comrade.

a1_saucier.name: A-1 Saucier
a1_saucier.statusText: You've never been bland, but now: a little richer, a little tangier, and a little more likely to enjoy dribbling down someone's chin than ever before. You're an  A-1 Saucier. Saucy!

able_chopper.name: Able Chopper
able_chopper.desc: Minced, chopped and hacked 11 recipes with a Knife & Board.
able_chopper.statusText: Good knife skills! You've earned the title Able Chopper.

about_average_irrigationist.name: About Average Irrigationist
about_average_irrigationist.statusText: So far, the Egg Plants seem to like what you're putting out. With practically no complaints coming in, you are now officially an About Average Irrigationist.

ace_of_om.name: Ace of Om
ace_of_om.desc: Practiced meditation for a sum total of 23 minutes
ace_of_om.statusText: You've spent a total of 23 minutes meditating. As a newly minted Ace of Om, you're on the pathway to nirvana. We hope you packed a lunch.

ace_propagationist.name: Ace Propagationist
ace_propagationist.statusText: O, frabjous day! You've planted your 401st crop! You've achieved Ace Propagationist status.

advanced_larva_lover.name: Advanced Larva Lover
advanced_larva_lover.desc: Fed 103 Caterpillars until they metamorphosized into Butterflies
advanced_larva_lover.statusText: By our count, that's 103 Caterpillars you've lovingly nurtured through those trying juvenile years and into those trying adult years. The least we can do is award you this Advanced Larva Lover badge.

advanced_spice_collector.name: Advanced Spice Collector
advanced_spice_collector.statusText: You've braved Tickly Nose Syndrome to harvest 1009 odoriferant Spices. By all accounts, you are now an Advanced Spice Collector.

affable_anthony.name: Affable Anthony
affable_anthony.desc: Popped round to 101 different home streets
affable_anthony.statusText: You've either got a lot of close friends, or just like wandering through other people's front yards. Whichever way, you've just earned yourself a badge for it. You go, Affable Anthony.

aftershock_award.name: Aftershock Award
aftershock_award.statusText: Whoa! Did you feel the ground move? For drinking 11 Earthshakers, you definitely deserve an Aftershock Award.

aggressive_agrarian.name: Aggressive Agrarian
aggressive_agrarian.statusText: You've sown 157 Herbs. If anyone deserves the 157-Herb-Planting badge it is, quite LITERALLY, you.

alakol_completist.name: Alakol Completist
alakol_completist.statusText: You've walked every misty cliff-top in Alakol, and gazed out to sea over the rocky mounds that line its glorious shores. You may not be master of all you survey, but you ARE master of the title Alakol Completist. Mazeltov.

all_giant_emblems.name: Super-Sized Sycophant
all_giant_emblems.desc: Collected one of each Giant Emblems
all_giant_emblems.statusText: Zounds! For collecting one of each Emblem of the Giants, we honor you with the designation of Super-Sized Sycophant. It denotes the glory of 11,000 favor points, all in one hard-to-pronounce title.

all_right_hatcher.name: All Right Hatcher
all_right_hatcher.desc: Incubated three Eggs, with some help from a Chicken
all_right_hatcher.statusText: You've just incubated three Eggs! Though, technically, a Chicken did most of the work. But Chickens hate awards, so here. This All Right Hatcher award is for you.

amateur_agronomist.name: Amateur Agronomist
amateur_agronomist.statusText: Congratulations! Beyond a seed of doubt, you've earned an Amateur Agronomist badge.

amateur_bean_tree_fondler.name: Amateur Bean Tree Fondler
amateur_bean_tree_fondler.statusText: It's been noted that you enjoy dabbling in the Bean Tree planting arts. For that, please enjoy the title Amateur Bean Tree Fondler.

amateur_decrustifier.name: Amateur Decrustifier
amateur_decrustifier.statusText: Sure, scraping 41 Barnacles may not require any special skill, but it does demand a gung-ho spirit and a heroic disregard for scabby knuckles. For this, you've earned the title Amateur Decrustifier.

amorphous_crystallizer.name: Amorphous Crystallizer
amorphous_crystallizer.statusText: Well, well, looky here. With this, your 79th Plain Crystal, you've earned the not-terribly-self-explanatory title Amorphous Crystallizer.

andra_completist.name: Andra Completist
andra_completist.statusText: You've ranged across the great serengetiesque plains of Andra, and admired every small rocky lump, every scrubby hillock, and every dry grassy knoll as far as the eye can see. Which - as any Andra Completist (that's you!) will tell you - is a very, very long way.

antisocial_hi_skipper.name: Marathon Maverick
antisocial_hi_skipper.desc: Set 37 Daily Records for Hi Sign evasion. Daily Records are recognized at the end of each game day
antisocial_hi_skipper.statusText: No stranger to being a stranger, you've run so far and so fast from friendly greetings that you've garnered 37 daily records for Hi Sign Evasion. Howdy, Stranger. And Mazel Tov, Maverick: here's your badge.

apprentice_lepidopteral_manipulator.name: Apprentice Lepidopteral Manipulator
apprentice_lepidopteral_manipulator.statusText: The official massage-o-meter indicates that you've administered 23 enthusiastic, if amateurish, Butterfly massages. You've earned the title of Apprentice Lepidopteral Manipular.

aranna_completist.name: Aranna Completist
aranna_completist.statusText: Like a tiny mountain goat or a nun wearing curtains, you scaled the dizzying alps of Rook-filled Aranna. Which earns you a badge AND this song: High on a hill lived an Arannan Completist, Lei-yodel-eii-yodel-eh-hii-WOO!

ascended.name: Ascended
ascended.desc: You ascended at the time of the Great Reset. Future glitcheologists will know one thing: in the beginning, you were there.
ascended.statusText: You ascended! Congrats! Way into the future, when Glitcheologists look back upon this time, many things will be a mystery. But if nothing else, this badge will make one thing clear to them: In the beginning, there was you.

ascended_level101.name: Hypersupermagic Clareangel
ascended_level101.desc: When the time of the Great Reset came, you had reached at least level 101. Then you ascended, resplendent, and entered the Glitch Hall of WIN.
ascended_level101.statusText: In the beginning of time, the rank of Hypersupermagic Clareangel was created for those who reached higher than Level 101 during Beta. It was never expected to be claimed. Then you came along. Lucky, eh? Yes, the name is merely a fortuitous coincidence. Honest.

ascended_level11.name: Beta Cherub
ascended_level11.desc: When the time of the Great Reset came, you had reached at least level 11. Then you ascended, and history will remember you forever.
ascended_level11.statusText: In the ranks of glory, you will be remembered forever as one of the ones who helped paved the way for all the other Glitches that followed, and, what's more, reached a double digit level while doing it. Kudos, little Beta Cherub.

ascended_level23.name: Beta Seraph
ascended_level23.desc: When the time of the Great Reset came, you had reached at least level 23. Then you ascended, and became part of the Glitchean firmament.
ascended_level23.statusText: Beta Seraphim may sound like a particularly interesting classification of pharmaceuticals, it is actually the technical term for elite Glitches that, at the time of the Great Reset, had reached at least level 23. Glory be unto you.

ascended_level31.name: Beta Ophan
ascended_level31.desc: When the time of the Great Reset came, you had reached at least level 31. Then you ascended, and became part of The Great Gitchurian Canon.
ascended_level31.statusText: When Glitchurian Scholars talk of the Beta Ophans, they do not mean the children of early Glitchers, neglected while their parents were busy filing bug reports. They mean the Ophanim, the esteemed few who made it to a level greater than 31 before ascending. Glory be to you, Beta Ophan!

ascended_level41.name: Shiny Happy Beta Angel
ascended_level41.desc: When the time of the Great Reset came, you had reached at least level 41. Then you ascended, and entered the annals of Glitchean history.
ascended_level41.statusText: Glitchorian lore will forever record that in The Great Before, some Glitches stretched their wings and levelled up like there was no tomorrow. As it turned out, there wasn't. But they still ascended above level 41, and were thus crowned Shiny Happy Beta Angels. Glory be!

ascended_level61.name: Archangel of Beta
ascended_level61.desc: When the time of the Great Reset came, you had reached at least level 61. Then you ascended, and entered the realms of Glitchian legend.
ascended_level61.statusText: In the mists of future, Glitchistorians will look back at the era known as 'Before The Sooooooon', and only dare to whisper the names of those who made it to the level of Archangel before the Great Reset came. Yours will be one of those names.

ascended_level83.name: Archistratege of Beta
ascended_level83.desc: When the time of the Great Reset came, you had reached at least level 83. Then you ascended, and entered the canon of Glitchian rumorlore.
ascended_level83.statusText: Above the Archangels, in the realms of Ur's atmosphere where only the Giants, the devs, and possibly Clare could see the top of your Glitchy little head, you rose to the level of Archistratege of Beta before having your mighty wings clipped by The Great Reset (only to rise again).

aspirational_home_improver.name: Aspirational Home Improver
aspirational_home_improver.statusText: Plain and simple were not enough for you, and who can blame you. 11 exciting furniture upgrades later, you have 11 beautiful pieces of upgraded furniture, AND this badge. Aspirational!

assistant_spice_manager.name: Assistant Spice Manager
assistant_spice_manager.statusText: Converting 503 spices is nothing to sneeze at. It's serious business, which is why you have now been promoted to Assistant Spice Manager.

assistant_to_the_mending_manager_kitchen.name: Assistant to the Mending Manager, Kitchen Division
assistant_to_the_mending_manager_kitchen.desc: Used a Tinkertool to repair 23 cooking tools from their half-life to a fully-repaired state
assistant_to_the_mending_manager_kitchen.statusText: You've wielded your Tinkertool to great avail. You deserve this promotion to the rank of Assistant to the Mending Manager, Kitchen Division.

awesome_apothecary.name: Awesome Apothecary
awesome_apothecary.statusText: What's the secret blend of herbs and spices? Well, the spiciness is you, you little firecracker, and the herbs are the 1009 that you're getting this here badge for planting.

bacon_biter.name: Bacon Biter
bacon_biter.statusText: No doubt about it: you like a little Piggy now and again. And clearly they like it when you bite their bacon, hence this here Bacon Biter badge.

balzare_completist.name: Balzare Completist
balzare_completist.statusText: Boo! Did I scare you? Never was good at scaring. Kind of creepy out here though and I heard you traveled this whole place. Huh? No I won't tell you who told me, then it wouldn't be scary ... right?? But here's a super spooky badge instead.

baqala_completist.name: Baqala Completist
baqala_completist.statusText: From east to west, north to south (if only those directions meant the same here as they do wherever you're from), you've criss-crossed the grid of perilous pathways, all the time bearing the weight of overwhelming ancestral nostalgia for just long enough to earn the title: Baqala Completist. You're amazing.

bar_fly.name: Bar Fly
bar_fly.statusText: You brought the metal. And then you turned it into 57 metal bars. You're FLY, Sly, and no mistake. You're fly and you made bars. Have a badge, Bar Fly!

barman_of_death.name: Barman of Death
barman_of_death.desc: Ended the useful life of 3 cultivated items using Wine of the Dead
barman_of_death.statusText: For whatever reason, you decided time was up for three cultivated objects, and dispatched them with Wine of the Dead. But you have to ask: if it can wipe out a rock, what the heckfire is it doing to your liver?

basic_beangrower.name: Basic Bean-Grower
basic_beangrower.statusText: Way to stick that bean in the ground! You've earned a Basic Bean-Grower badge.

basic_larva_lover.name: Basic Larva Lover
basic_larva_lover.desc: Fed three Caterpillars until they metamorphosized into Butterflies
basic_larva_lover.statusText: You've nourished three wiggly Caterpillars into the full bloom of fluttery Butterflyhood. You've earned a Basic Larva Lover badge.

bathed_in_sloth_slobber.name: Bathed in Sloth-Slobber
bathed_in_sloth_slobber.desc: Spat at by a sloth 101 times
bathed_in_sloth_slobber.statusText: Sure your clothes are soaked through with the sticky slobber of 101 sloths that just won't wash out, but it's worth it for the snails, right? And the badge! Yay badges!

bead_threader.name: Bead Threader
bead_threader.desc: Carefully reconstructed one ancient artifact necklace
bead_threader.statusText: Bead by bead, you reassembled one of the necklaces of the ancients. Pretty! Pretty AND badgeworthy!

bean_counter.name: Bean Counter
bean_counter.statusText: Clearly this Bean harvesting is more than just a hobby for you. You are now a fully fledged Bean Counter.

bean_counter_pro.name: Bean Counter Pro
bean_counter_pro.statusText: Bean Counter Pro isn't just a title. It's a way of life. A way that involves a lot of Beans.

beanorator_1st_class.name: Beanorator 1st Class
beanorator_1st_class.statusText: Somewhere out there are 503 basic Beans that are now fancy Beans, and they have you to thank. You get a Beanorator 1st Class badge out of this deal.

beanorator_2nd_class.name: Beanorator 2nd Class
beanorator_2nd_class.statusText: Congratulations on converting 53 basic Beans into fancy Beans. You can add a Beanorator 2nd Class badge to your collection.

beginner_decoctifier.name: Beginner Decoctifier
beginner_decoctifier.statusText: You're starting to know your way around the kitchen. You've earned a Beginner Decoctifier badge!

beginner_drizzler.name: Beginner Drizzler
beginner_drizzler.desc: Administered a much-needed watering to 11 hot Spice Plants
beginner_drizzler.statusText: Seems counter-intuitive to offer Spice Plants water, but even they get hot sometimes. For your out-of-the-box style of thinkery, you've been dubbed a Beginner Drizzler.

besara_completist.name: Besara Completist
besara_completist.statusText: Each lush leafy street in Besara is like a second home to you now. Or, at least, "like a street you have visited", if "second home" is a little strong, because you have walked down them all, you Besara Completist you.

best_nester.name: Best Nester
best_nester.desc: Incubated 17 Eggs, with some help from a Chicken
best_nester.statusText: If there's anything nobler than bringing new life into the world, it's bringing 17 new lives into the world. For incubating so many Eggs, you've earned this Best Nester award.

best_pal.name: Best Pal
best_pal.statusText: 111 is, according to science, the perfect size for a social circle. Which makes you, Best Pal with a badge to prove it, the perfect social scientist.

better_bubble_farmer.name: Better Bubble Farmer
better_bubble_farmer.statusText: You've been initiated into the secret order of Better Bubble Farmers. Consider their motto: 'Sometimes you eat the bubble, and sometimes the bubble eats you.' Nobody knows if this has ever actually meant anything.

better_homes_and_gardens.name: Better Homes and Gardens
better_homes_and_gardens.desc: Upgraded each furniture base item at least once
better_homes_and_gardens.statusText: Not content with "base" furniture, you've upgraded every different piece you could. So, all of them, then. No wonder people look up to you. You and your Better Homes and Gardens badge, of course.

betterthanaverage_mulcher.name: Better-Than-Average Mulcher
betterthanaverage_mulcher.statusText: Wow! You've hoed a lot of weedy patches! We hope it wasn't too harrowing. You deserve a Better-Than-Average Mulcher badge.

betterthanlousy_douser.name: Better-Than-Lousy Douser
betterthanlousy_douser.desc: Dispensed a good watering to 41 Bean Trees
betterthanlousy_douser.statusText: When you water a Bean Tree, it stays watered. For a while, anyway. You deserve our second-finest Bean Tree watering honour: the title Better-Than-Lousy Douser.

betterthanmediocre_fruit_tree_pettifier.name: Better-Than-Mediocre Fruit Tree Pettifier
betterthanmediocre_fruit_tree_pettifier.statusText: These Fruit Trees may have had better petting, but they've had worse, too. Celebrate your adequateness with your newfound title Better-Than-Mediocre Fruit Tree Pettifier.

big_league_decrustifier.name: Big League Decrustifier
big_league_decrustifier.statusText: No doubt you have other passions in life. Philanthropy. The opera. And so on. You just also happen to be a deft hand with a Barnacle Scraper, hence your newly earned title, Big League Decrustifier.

big_spender.name: Big Spender
big_spender.desc: Made a purchase worth 1009 or more currants
big_spender.statusText: Celebrating this biggish purchase with a Big Spender badge could lead to big things for you. Such as a big case of buyer's remorse.

big_splasher.name: Big Splasher
big_splasher.desc: Administered a much-needed watering to 41 hot Spice Plants
big_splasher.statusText: The more water you splash around on hot Spice plants, the cooler you are. And we're talking old school rat pack cool here, hence your new title, Big Splasher. There might even be a song about you.

bigger_league_decrustifier.name: Bigger League Decrustifier
bigger_league_decrustifier.statusText: Just when you thought the big league of Barnacle scraping couldn't get any bigger, it went and did. You know what this makes you, of course? Yes. A Bigger League Decrustifier.

blendmaster.name: Blendmaster
blendmaster.desc: Blended 41 drinks or sno cones with a Blender.
blendmaster.statusText: You've blended, blended and blended some more until your blender-button finger was numb, and your brain rang with the song of the blender. It was worth it though, 41 drinks later. Bravo, Blendmaster.

bonafide_gas_wrangler.name: Bonafide Gas Wrangler
bonafide_gas_wrangler.statusText: You turned 503 natural Gases into something better than natural. You're a Bonafide Gas Wrangler, and have the faraway stare, the crazy hair, the squeaky voice and the rook-may-care attitude to prove it.

bonbon_vivant.name: Bonbon Vivant
bonbon_vivant.statusText: Mangia! Mangia! For eating 101 meals, you've earned the title of Bonbon Vivant.

bootleg_facilitator.name: Bootleg Facilitator
bootleg_facilitator.desc: Diligently distilled 913 Hooches in your back yard
bootleg_facilitator.statusText: You let nothing stand in your way in your bid to become one of Ur's no.1 booze-fountains. 913 Hooches later, here you are. Sláinte!

bortola_completist.name: Bortola Completist
bortola_completist.statusText: You've tiptoed through every hushed and dusky thoroughfare in Bortola, and wherever you go from now on, they will whisper your newly-bestowed title: Bortola Completist. They might whisper it quite quietly, though, so don't hold your breath.

bounder_tenured.name: Bounder, Tenured
bounder_tenured.desc: Jumped with nigh-Olympian skill and grace exactly 111,111 times
bounder_tenured.statusText: Look before you leap? Pah! That's for amatoors. Show the world you've gone pro with your official Tenured Bounder status.

bounder_untenured.name: Bounder, Untenured
bounder_untenured.statusText: Can you believe it? We've been keeping track of how many times you've jumped, and it's a lot! Consider yourself an Untenured Bounder. But you're on the fast track, friend.

bowser.name: Bowser
bowser.desc: Refueled 5 machines in other players' home streets or yards, or machine rooms
bowser.statusText: You're like the friendly neighbourhood gas pump, refuelling machines for all and sundry. For your generosity, gentle Bowser, a badge. Bravo!

brazier_apprentice.name: Brazier Apprentice
brazier_apprentice.desc: Delicately charred 11 dishes with a Famous Pugilist Grill.
brazier_apprentice.statusText: You can stand the heat and stay in the kitchen. You are hereby awarded a Brazier Apprentice badge.

brillah_completist.name: Brillah Completist
brillah_completist.statusText: Tiny and determined, you've scuttled over every inch of Brillah. From the highest heights to the most pleasing plateau, you felt yourself dwarfed by the soaring scenery, like a tiny explorey ant. You deserve a badge, little Brillah Ant! Brilliant!

broil_king.name: Broil King
broil_king.desc: Delicately charred 137 dishes with a Famous Pugilist Grill.
broil_king.statusText: Kiss the cook? Don't mind if we do! You are hereby awarded the title of Broil King.

bubble_coaxer.name: Bubble Coaxer
bubble_coaxer.statusText: Pat yourself on the back for converting 53 basic Bubbles into fancier Bubbles. You've earned a Bubble Coaxer badge.

bubble_tea_aficionado.name: Bubble Tea Aficionado
bubble_tea_aficionado.statusText: Do your insides feel oxygenated? Are there flurries of bubbles in your undercarriage? That's because you've drunk 11 Bubble Teas, you Aficionado, you. Have a badge!

bubble_transubstantiator.name: Bubble Transubstantiator
bubble_transubstantiator.statusText: Your deftness in wielding a Bubble Tuner has spread throughout the land. Proclaim your Bubble mastery from the rooftops with your new Bubble Transubstantiator badge in hand.

bush_whacker.name: Bush Whacker
bush_whacker.desc: Administered a sound petting to 41 Gas Plants
bush_whacker.statusText: Goodness, that's a lot of petting. You are hereby awarded the title Bush Whacker. Just remember to keep those busy hands outside the bark.

butterfly_whisperer.name: Butterfly Whisperer
butterfly_whisperer.statusText: Zoinks! You somehow persuaded 3 tricksy butterflies to yield to your tickly touch. What are you, some kind of Butterfly Whisperer? In fact: Yes. That's exactly what you are. Have a badge.

callopee_completist.name: Callopee Completist
callopee_completist.statusText: You wove through the treacherous pointy uppy-downy spiky rocks, burrowed through locked doors, chipped away at every dead end and lived to tell the tale. The tale entitled "How I Became A Callopee Completist".

candy_caner.name: Candy Caner
candy_caner.statusText: Why does Zilloween candy always taste so much better in the season of zilloween? I don't know, but it DOES. IT TASTES OF MAGIC AND JOYBALLS AND THUNDER AND YAY!

candy_muncher.name: Candy Muncher
candy_muncher.statusText: You know that heart-thumping brain-fizzling illicit sugar rush you get from eating holiday candy at holiday time? Well, you do, because you've had that a whole 17 times. WHEEEEE!!!!

candy_nommer.name: Candy Nommer
candy_nommer.statusText: There's something magical that happens to zilloween candy during the candy season that makes it taste extra special. What is it? No idea. But you've nommed 79 pieces.

candy_snaffler.name: Candy Snaffler
candy_snaffler.statusText: SQUEEEEEE! FULL ON HOLIDAY SUGAR-BASED SEROTONIN RUSH FROM HOLIDAY CANDY LIKE 43 TIMES, MAN! 43 TIMES! WOOO!

candy_stripper.name: Candy Stripper
candy_stripper.statusText: Who wants candy? Apparently you do, because you stripped paper from 353 Zilloween candies during the appropriate sugar-buzz season and ate them all. Somehow, only Zille knows how, you still have teeth.

capon_caterer.name: Capon Caterer
capon_caterer.statusText: Without you, there would be 103 fewer Chickens in the world. Would this be a great loss? Who can say. Regardless, enjoy your newfound title, Capon Caterer.

captain_of_the_anti_temperance_league.name: Captain of the Anti-Temperance League
captain_of_the_anti_temperance_league.desc: Dutifully distilled 3331 Hooches in your back yard
captain_of_the_anti_temperance_league.statusText: Your name is whispered in disapproving tones by stern-looking teetotallers in big hats, but drinkers everywhere are grateful for your dutiful service. Unless you distilled all 3331 Hooches to drink yourself, in which case: Woah, dude. Prost!

captain_tchotchke.name: Captain Tchotchke
captain_tchotchke.statusText: Some believe in a minimalism, choosing items that are useful, and only useful. Others go the other way, and fill their lives with things that are decorative but useless. You… well, no judgies. Here's your badge.

card_carrying_qualification.name: Card-Carrying Qualification
card_carrying_qualification.statusText: Your name has been entered in the great ledger and here you are, another cog in the machine, another brick in the wall, another loyal denizen of the state, able to carry or use any bureaucratic item you like. Arise, Card-carrier.

cauda_completist.name: Cauda Completist
cauda_completist.statusText: I sure wish I could give those foxes a good brushing! You make it look like so much fun … the way you pretend to miss with your brush all the time and how the bait sometimes lands on your head after it explodes. I am honored to present you with this complimentary Cauda completist badge!

certified_boozehound.name: Certified Boozehound
certified_boozehound.statusText: You can sniff out a snifter of booze at fifty planks and snaffle it before anyone has the chance to say "Cheers!". You're a Certified Boozehound and have the badge to prove it. Prost!

chairman_of_the_board.name: Chairman of the Board
chairman_of_the_board.statusText: You bound yourself to the board-making cause, making board after board without ever apparently getting bored. You deserve a little something, Chairman of the Board.

chakra_phool_completist.name: Chakra Phool Completist
chakra_phool_completist.desc: Visited every location in Chakra Phool
chakra_phool_completist.statusText: Why do fireflies suddenly appear, every time you are near? Perhaps because they can tell that you've climbed every stairway and walked every road in Chakra Phool, until you found your dream. Your dream being the title "Chakra Phool Completist". Well done.

chatterbox.name: Chatterbox
chatterbox.statusText: You've got a real gift for gab. You've earned a Chatterbox badge!

cheesemongerer.name: Cheesemongerer
cheesemongerer.desc: Unlocked the mystery of turning ordinary butterfly milk into cheese
cheesemongerer.statusText: You've discovered the key to cheese alchemy! You are hereby awarded the title of Cheesemongerer.

chicken_tender.name: Chicken Tender
chicken_tender.desc: Raised 3 Chicks to the full bloom of adult chickenhood
chicken_tender.statusText: You've lovingly raised 3 Chicks to the full bloom of adult chickenhood. They grow up so quickly, don't they? Never mind, you. Here's a Chicken Tender badge to reward your poultering efforts.

chief_bubble_tree_cuddler.name: Chief Bubble Tree Cuddler
chief_bubble_tree_cuddler.statusText: When it comes to tree petting, you sure do get around. In some places, the title Chief Bubble Tree Cuddler might be a scarlet letter. Luckily, here you're a star.

chief_inspector_coppersmith.name: Chief Inspector Coppersmith
chief_inspector_coppersmith.desc: Vigorously rubbed, tugged and massaged 501 Plain Metal Ingots into Copper
chief_inspector_coppersmith.statusText: This marks the 501st Plain Ingot you've rubbed into Copper. Revel in your newfound title of Chief Inspector Coppersmith. But make the revels snappy, before your stash turns green.

chief_of_tinkering_operations.name: Chief of Tinkering Operations
chief_of_tinkering_operations.desc: Wielded a Tinkertool to repair 2503 units worth of tools
chief_of_tinkering_operations.statusText: After endlessly tinkering in the shadows, you can finally get the respect you deserve with this new title: Chief of Tinkering Operations. Token? Sure. But sounds good at parties.

chore_buff.name: Chore Buff
chore_buff.desc: Ranked as top 5 contributors for 37 phases of a project
chore_buff.statusText: In recognization of the above-and-beyond-ness of your Project participation, please accept this Chore Buff badge. We made it just for you.

choru_completist.name: Choru Completist
choru_completist.statusText: They laughed when you said you'd have the staying power to make it down every dusty street in Choru. But then you did. Who's laughing now? You are. You and your beautiful Choru Completist Badge. Laugh on, little explorer.

chowhound.name: Chowhound
chowhound.statusText: Yummo! You've figured out a lot of recipes. You've earned a Chowhound badge.

chute_jockey.name: Chute Jockey
chute_jockey.statusText: You've taken the subway 503 times while still retaining your childlike love of Glitch-manity. That deserves a reward. And that reward will be this Chute Jockey badge.

circle_crunch.name: Circle Crunch
circle_crunch.desc: Got three sloths to eat your rods simultaneously
circle_crunch.statusText: There's no feeling in the world like three simultaneous sloths nibbling on your rods. You'd think that feeling would be reward enough in itself. But you'd be wrong: here's a badge. Wahey!

clumsy1.name: Clumsy
clumsy1.statusText: You've croaked three times - oops! You've just earned a Clumsy badge. Maybe it will remind you to be more careful.

coat_of_open_arms.name: Coat of Open Arms
coat_of_open_arms.statusText: Your rapacious loquaciousness has just earned you a Coat of Open Arms. We salute you!

cold_as_ice.name: Cold as Ice
cold_as_ice.desc: Chillily scraped 877 Ice from the Nubbin
cold_as_ice.statusText: You're as Cold As Ice, you're willing to scrape the ice for cubes. 877 of them, in fact. Aw yeah.

collection_all_emblems.name: Emblems Trophy
collection_all_emblems.desc: Held the Emblems of all 11 Giants in your inventory at once

collection_cubimals.name: Series 1 Cubimal Wrangler
collection_cubimals.desc: Collected all varieties of Series 1 Cubimals.

collection_cubimals_2.name: Series 2 Cubimal Wrangler
collection_cubimals_2.desc: Collected all varieties of Series 2 Cubimals.

collection_egg_hunter.name: Egg Hunter Trophy
collection_egg_hunter.statusText: Your enthusiasm for Egg collection has been acknowledged! You've more than earned this stylish, but inedible Egg Hunter Trophy.

collection_street_creator_dirt.name: Street Creator Dirt Trophy
collection_street_creator_dirt.desc: Collected all pieces of the Street Creator Dirt Trophy

collection_street_creator_earth.name: Street Creator Earth Trophy
collection_street_creator_earth.desc: Collected all pieces of the Street Creator Earth Trophy

collection_street_creator_rock.name: Street Creator Rock Trophy
collection_street_creator_rock.desc: Collected all pieces of the Street Creator Rock Trophy

collection_street_creator_wood.name: Street Creator Wood Trophy
collection_street_creator_wood.desc: Collected all pieces of the Street Creator Wood Trophy

common_snail_collector.name: Common Snail Collector
common_snail_collector.statusText: You persuaded a sloth to cough up 101 snails. Yippee, Common Snail Collector! You're on the ladder of ultimate snail collection now. Have a badge!

commuter_mug.name: Commuter Mug
commuter_mug.statusText: Felicitations! You've fearlessly braved stepped-on toes and the stinky pits of your fellow travellers, thereby earning the title of Commuter Mug.

competent_windbag.name: Competent Windbag
competent_windbag.statusText: Your way with windbaggery is a wonder to behold! You've earned the title Competent Windbag.

compulsive_moisturizer.name: Compulsive Moisturizer
compulsive_moisturizer.statusText: Without people like you, Egg Plants would grow tiny desiccated egg-shaped nubbins, filled with egg-flavored powder. But you, and other Compulsive Moisturizers like you ensure the inside of every egg is runny, ripe, and ready to eat. Badged!

compulsive_re_peater.name: Compulsive Re-Peater
compulsive_re_peater.desc: Harvested 283 slightly funky Blocks of Peat
compulsive_re_peater.statusText: You know what they say about harvesting Blocks of Peat: once you start, you can't stop. Now you can celebrate your stick-to-it-iveness with the title Compulsive Re-Peater.

confident_petter.name: Confident Petter
confident_petter.statusText: It takes a confident person to pet 41 Spice Plants. That's probably why the award you've just earned is called the Confident Petter badge. Just a guess.

confounder_of_logic.name: Confounder of Logic
confounder_of_logic.statusText: Some people know the knowns, learning skills that are learnable. Some know the unknowns, learning Unlearning. But one step beyond them all, you have unlearned unlearning, and now unknow the unknown. How Rumsfeldian.

constable_coppersmith.name: Constable Coppersmith
constable_coppersmith.desc: Vigorously rubbed, tugged and massaged 41 Plain Metal Ingots into Copper
constable_coppersmith.statusText: Why settle for Plain Ingots when you can have much superior Copper? You've just been awarded the title of Constable. Hello, Constable Coppersmith.

corporate_cabinetmaker.name: Corporate Cabinetmaker
corporate_cabinetmaker.statusText: You made cabinets. Not everyone can make cabinets. But you can: and did.  You made 13 of them, and earned this beautiful badge. Now get out of here before I cry.

court_hoarder.name: Court Hoarder
court_hoarder.statusText: Every good hoarder loves a good Storage Display Box. You court the love of those hoarders, by making beautiful boxes. 53 of them! Take a badge and a bow, you gorgeous Court Hoarder you.

covered_in_epic_win.name: Covered in Epic Win
covered_in_epic_win.desc: Contributed to each feat in 13 epics
covered_in_epic_win.statusText: Words are not enough to describe how epic your commitment to the epics is. Hopefully, this badge goes a little way to conveying your epic Epic epicness. It's pretty epic.

crackpot_infuser.name: Crackpot Infuser
crackpot_infuser.statusText: You smushed herbs and hooch and other stuff into a thing far greater than the sum of its parts 253 times.

creditable_delver.name: Creditable Delver
creditable_delver.statusText: You've come a long way since you first picked up your pick. It's safe to say you've earned the title Creditable Delver.

crest_connoisseur.name: Crest Connoisseur
crest_connoisseur.desc: Exhaustively earned 151 Emblems of the Giants
crest_connoisseur.statusText: You've finally earned the title Crest Connoisseur. Aside from the awesome badge, the best thing about this honor is that it's perfectly acceptable - nay, even required - that you be mildly snooty to Fledgling Crest Collectors.

critter_catalyzer.name: Critter Catalyzer
critter_catalyzer.desc: Used Powder of Startling Fecundity on 5 critters at once.
critter_catalyzer.statusText: Bravissimo. Using a Powder of Startling Fecundity on five critters at once has made you eligible for the honorary title of Critter Catalyzer.

crowded_house.name: Crowded House
crowded_house.desc: Graciously hosted three guests at once in your house
crowded_house.statusText: It may not look too full, but if three's a crowd, then consider your house stuffed to the gills by the people you invited in. Phew! Is it hot in here, House Crowder?!

crucible_jockey.name: Crucible Jockey
crucible_jockey.desc: Smelted 127 Metal Ingots from purest Metal Rock
crucible_jockey.statusText: Consider the crucible. A metaphor for the soul-defining crises of the Glitchian experience? Or merely the first word of a somewhat cool-sounding badge name? Or possibly both!

cubimal_emancipationist.name: Cubimal Emancipationist
cubimal_emancipationist.statusText: Bound in racing servitude, 251 Cubimals were straining to be free.Thanks to you, they are. Words are not enough: so here's a badge. FREEDOM!

culinarian_supreme.name: Culinarian Supreme
culinarian_supreme.desc: Prepared 137 unique food and drink recipes
culinarian_supreme.statusText: You've really got your mise en place in place. Having made almost every food and drink item under the sun, you've earned the title Culinarian Supreme!

cultivation_nurturer.name: Cultivation Nurturer
cultivation_nurturer.desc: Nursed back to health 3 cultivation projects
cultivation_nurturer.statusText: When they were on their last legs, you restored 3 precious cultivation projects. Phew. And also, WOO!

cunning_like_a_foxbrusher.name: Cunning like a Foxbrusher
cunning_like_a_foxbrusher.desc: Brushed 31 foxes while they were moving
cunning_like_a_foxbrusher.statusText: Fast-moving vulpines are no match for your brilliant brain. Cunning Like a Foxbrusher, you've snatched fibers from 31 foxes on the move. You deserve a round of applause, and a badge. Here's the badge.

curious_george.name: Curious George
curious_george.desc: Assembled and Disassembled each of the 4 machines
curious_george.statusText: It's been noted that you're the kind of glitch that likes putting things together, then taking them apart again just to see how they work. Alph commends your spirit, little Curious George!

daily_hi_skipper.name: The Daily Hi-Skipper
daily_hi_skipper.desc: Set one Daily Record for Hi Sign evasion in a location. Daily Records are recognized at the end of each game day
daily_hi_skipper.statusText: When old day tipped into New Day, you were the record-holding Hi-Sign evader, for skipping out on one pesky Hi-Sign in one perfectly-picked place. Those signs are fast, but you were faster. For a while, anyways. Go you!

dandy_tincturer.name: Dandy Tincturer
dandy_tincturer.statusText: You squished herbs into their purest (and most alcoholic) tincturous form 87 times.

darwin_award_winner.name: Darwin Award Winner
darwin_award_winner.statusText: You've just won a not-so-coveted Darwin Award. You have insurance, right?

death_metallurgist.name: Death Metallurgist
death_metallurgist.desc: Professionally rubbed 501 Plain Metal Ingots into Molybdenum
death_metallurgist.statusText: Remember back when you earned the title Thrash Metallurgist? The feeling of teeth-gritted, hair-flapping glory? Well, cherish that feeling, times two, mon frere. You've just earned the title Death Metallurgist. The most hardcore Metallurgist there is.

decent_citizen.name: Decent Citizen
decent_citizen.statusText: Aw... doesn't giving feel good? And now let's give something to you: a Decent Citizen badge.

decent_hash_slinger.name: Decent Hash Slinger
decent_hash_slinger.desc: Fried up 11 meals with a Frying Pan.
decent_hash_slinger.statusText: You're coming along in the hash-slinging department. Here's a Decent Hash Slinger badge to prove it. And remember: When in doubt, just add butter.

decent_tree_hugger.name: Decent Tree Hugger
decent_tree_hugger.statusText: Your Tree petting is improving, but there's always room for improved improvement. While you work on that, enjoy this Decent Tree Hugger badge.

decrustifying_enthusiast.name: Decrustifying Enthusiast
decrustifying_enthusiast.statusText: When it comes to scraping Barnacles, what you lack in polish, you make up for in good old-fashioned Barnacle-scraping zeal. You've just won your own self the title Decrustifying Enthusiast.

dedicated_gas_fancier.name: Dedicated Gas Fancier
dedicated_gas_fancier.statusText: Your dedication, your fancy for gas, and dedicated gas harvesting in a fancy kind of way has reached the level of Dedicated Gas Fancier, which is both admirable, and somewhat expected. Still: fancy!

dedicated_meataterian.name: Dedicated Meataterian
dedicated_meataterian.statusText: You sure do enjoy your vittles. You've earned the title Dedicated Meataterian!

dedicated_restorationizer.name: Dedicated Restorationizer
dedicated_restorationizer.desc: Wore out and restored the same cultivated item 20 times
dedicated_restorationizer.statusText: On your watch, every cultivation project can breathe easy: especially this one - you've restored it 20 times, giving it the maximum lifespan of 200%. This cultivation project basically worships you. Have a badge!

dedicated_snail_getter.name: Dedicated Snail Getter
dedicated_snail_getter.statusText: Somehow, you persuaded the sloths to give up 1001 snails. It took dedication and a very smooth Sloth-charming style. Hats off to you, Snail Getter.

deeply_concerned_citizen.name: Deeply Concerned Citizen
deeply_concerned_citizen.desc: Helped out with 253 phases of a project
deeply_concerned_citizen.statusText: This marks the 253rd Project you've helped with. We struggled with what to name this badge. Hard Worker? Control Freak? We settled on Deeply Concerned Citizen.

definitelymuchbetter_tree_hugger.name: Definitely-Much-Better Tree Hugger
definitelymuchbetter_tree_hugger.statusText: There are tree huggers, and then there are tree huggers. And then there is you, a Definitely-Much-Better Tree Hugger.

delirious_foxbrusher.name: Delirious Foxbrusher
delirious_foxbrusher.desc: Brushed 10,009 fibers from the tails of foxes
delirious_foxbrusher.statusText: No wonder Ur's foxes are looking grumpy and a little threadbare: you've deliriously brushed 10,009 fibers from their tails. Wowzers! Have a badge!

dirt_diggler.name: Dirt Diggler
dirt_diggler.desc: Used a Shovel 503 times to dig Patches or Dirt Piles
dirt_diggler.statusText: Digging up 503 Patches or piles of dirt yields a lot of Earth, the odd bit of Loam, the coveted title Dirt Diggler, and a question: Are you ever planning to wash your hands?

dirt_monkey.name: Dirt Monkey
dirt_monkey.desc: Used a Shovel 61 times to dig Patches or Dirt Piles
dirt_monkey.statusText: Remember all those times your mom told you not to monkey around in the dirt? Show her this badge and tell her it's okay now.

dirtomancer.name: Dirtomancer
dirtomancer.desc: Used a Shovel 251 times to dig Patches or Dirt Piles
dirtomancer.statusText: Walk softly and carry a big shovel. If you knew how to embroider, that phrase would look mighty nice on a pillow. In lieu of a pillow, please accept this Dirtomancer badge.

domestic_completist.name: Domestic Completist
domestic_completist.desc: Crafted each furniture item at least once
domestic_completist.statusText: It takes a certain dedication to craft every single piece of furniture item at least once. You have that dedication, Domestic Completist. Also, you have every single piece of furniture. Oh, and a badge.

down_to_the_wire.name: Down To The Wire
down_to_the_wire.desc: Be one of the few Glitches to tip the scales. Make a contribution in the last 30 minutes of the feat, and with 5% or less left to contribute towards whichever goal is coming up next.
down_to_the_wire.statusText: In the dying moments of the feat, you made your mark. They couldn't have done it without you - well, maybe they could, but they didn't. Have a badge!

dracula.name: Dracula
dracula.statusText: You've croaked 1009 times! You've earned our highest undead honor, the Dracula badge.

dragon_chaser.name: Dragon Chaser
dragon_chaser.desc: Kept up No-No Rush for 11 minutes
dragon_chaser.statusText: Who knew you could keep a No-No Rush going for 11 minutes? This Dragon Chaser Badge will earn you the respect, if not the admiration, of your peers.

drifa_completist.name: Drifa Completist
drifa_completist.statusText: C-c-old. Brinngg. warmth... Trade you ... badge ...

dust_busting_trigger_trappist.name: Dust-Busting Trigger-Trappist
dust_busting_trigger_trappist.statusText: To trigger 126 Dust Traps might be mistaken for coincidence, but 127? That's badge-worthy. Here's your badge.

effervescence_consultant.name: Effervescence Consultant
effervescence_consultant.statusText: If a largish number of basic Bubbles need to be coaxed into an awesomer state, you are clearly the one to call. You've earned the title of Effervescence Consultant, and the badge that accompanies it.

egg_aficianado.name: Egg Aficionado
egg_aficianado.statusText: Eggs - they're not just for breakfast anymore.' This would be the battle cry of the Egg Aficionado... if Egg Aficionados were into battle crying. Mostly, though, they just quietly harvest Eggs. Welcome to the club.

egg_enthusiast.name: Egg Enthusiast
egg_enthusiast.statusText: Who doesn't enjoy harvesting a pile of Eggs now and again? Is that a trick question? You are hereby awarded the title Egg Enthusiast.

egg_freak.name: Egg Freak
egg_freak.statusText: Most people don't understand what it means to harvest 5003 eggs, but as one of the few true Egg Freaks, you do. Now you have the badge to show for it. Semper fritatta.

egg_plant_coddler.name: Egg Plant Coddler
egg_plant_coddler.desc: Administered firm pettings to 11 Egg Plants
egg_plant_coddler.statusText: Petting is natural and healthy - even the way you do it. There is hardly any reason at all why you shouldn't be promoted to Egg Plant Coddler status.

egg_poacher.name: Egg Poacher
egg_poacher.statusText: Congratulations, Egg lover. You've just earned the title of Egg Poacher. It sounds all dangerous, but really you're just a regular person. A regular person who likes Eggs.

egg_transmutator_apprentice.name: Egg Transmutator Apprentice
egg_transmutator_apprentice.statusText: 53 Eggs seasoned, eh? Well, it's a start. You now have an Egg Transmutator Apprentice badge to hang on your wall. If you have a wall, that is.

egg_transmutator_maxipro.name: Egg Transmutator Maxi-Pro
egg_transmutator_maxipro.statusText: Some might consider the title Egg Transmutator Maxi-Pro goofy. Undignified for someone who has seasoned 2003 eggs. Well, that's just their opinion.

egg_transmutator_pro.name: Egg Transmutator Pro
egg_transmutator_pro.statusText: Being a professional-caliber Egg seasoner might mean people will give you more respect and free drinks. Maybe. But at the very least you get an Egg Transmutator Pro badge out of the deal.

eggy_wegger.name: Eggy Wegger
eggy_wegger.statusText: Who likes their eggy-weggies? You do! You've earned the Eggy-Wegger badge.

el_big_spenderino.name: El Big Spenderino
el_big_spenderino.desc: Made a purchase worth 2003 or more currants
el_big_spenderino.statusText: You've just blown 2003 or more currants. Hope it was worth it. In case it wasn't, at least you can show this badge and tell people that once upon a time, you were an El Big Spenderino.

elbow_grease_monkey.name: Elbow Grease Monkey
elbow_grease_monkey.desc: Ranked as top 5 contributors for 79 phases of a project
elbow_grease_monkey.statusText: You're never afraid to roll up your sleeves and show us just how greasy your elbows can get. Elbow Grease Monkey seemed like an appropriate honorific.

elementary_penguin.name: Elementary Penguin
elementary_penguin.statusText: A time, a place, some yellow matter custard, three vials of Purple essence, a semolina pilchard climbing up the eiffel tower, one journey, one glitch. Who is the eggman? You are the eggman. Goo goo ga joob.

eleven_secret_locations.name: 11 Clusters of DNAja vu
eleven_secret_locations.desc: Stumbled on 11 clusters of DNAja vu
eleven_secret_locations.statusText: You roamed the land until you connected with 11 clusters of your giantly DNA, little Gene Genie. You feel closely connected to your roots AND have a shiny new badge. Win-win!

elixir_enthusiast.name: Elixir Enthusiast
elixir_enthusiast.statusText: Faster than a speeding chicken! Higher than a Groddle pine! Potions get you there. Or, at least make you feel like you're there. SHAZAM!!!

emblem_skill_unlock_alph_1.name: Spent First Emblem of Alph
emblem_skill_unlock_alph_1.desc: Gained the ability to scale the heights of tinkery with Tinkering IV
emblem_skill_unlock_alph_1.statusText: Whoa... do you feel it? Tingling fingers? Itchy palms? Greasy elbows? No, it's not a medical emergency. It's just the power of Alph conferring upon you the ability to learn Tinkering IV.

emblem_skill_unlock_cosma_1.name: Spent First Emblem of Cosma
emblem_skill_unlock_cosma_1.desc: Earned the ability to acquire Meditative Arts III, the serenest of all the Meditative arts
emblem_skill_unlock_cosma_1.statusText: Feeling serene? Now you can get serener! With the unlocking of this emblem, you can acquire Meditative Arts III, which, to be frank, makes Meditative Arts I and II look kind of sick.

emblem_skill_unlock_friendly_1.name: Spent First Emblem of Friendly
emblem_skill_unlock_friendly_1.desc: Earned the right to learn the hallowed secrets of Cocktail Crafting II
emblem_skill_unlock_friendly_1.statusText: The hallowed secrets of Cocktail Crafting II are shared only with the select few who unlock the First Emblem of Friendly. Should you choose to acquire this skill, you will learn to make drinks of mind-boggling fanciness and fancy-boggling mindfulness.

emblem_skill_unlock_grendaline_1.name: Spent First Emblem of Grendaline
emblem_skill_unlock_grendaline_1.desc: Earned the privilege of learning Light Green Thumb III
emblem_skill_unlock_grendaline_1.statusText: Look at your thumb. Could it be greener? The answer is yes. With this unlocking comes access to Light Green Thumb III. It's like Light Green Thumb II, but better.

emblem_skill_unlock_humbaba_1.name: Spent First Emblem of Humbaba
emblem_skill_unlock_humbaba_1.desc: Earned the right to learn the slightly whiffy secrets of Animal Kinship VI
emblem_skill_unlock_humbaba_1.statusText: Click! And behold! The slightly whiffy secrets of Animal Kinship VI are yours for the taking. If you dare. (You should probably dare.)

emblem_skill_unlock_lem_1.name: Spent First Emblem of Lem
emblem_skill_unlock_lem_1.desc: Gained the ability to learn Teleportation III
emblem_skill_unlock_lem_1.statusText: This mighty unlocking opens the doors to Teleportation III. Should you choose to learn this skill, you will be able to teleport with less energy, save one more teleportation point, and be just one step away from Teleportation IV where things really get interesting.

emblem_skill_unlock_mab_1.name: Spent First Emblem of Mab
emblem_skill_unlock_mab_1.desc: Earned the privilege of learning Soil Appreciation IV
emblem_skill_unlock_mab_1.statusText: Ambitious soil appreciators know that unlocking the First Emblem of Mab is a crucial step. If you're prepared to get your hands dirty... er, dirtier... Soil Appreciation IV is now yours for the taking.

emblem_skill_unlock_pot_1.name: Spent First Emblem of Pot
emblem_skill_unlock_pot_1.desc: Gained the right to learn the savory secrets of Master Chef II
emblem_skill_unlock_pot_1.statusText: You've unharnessed the savory favor of Pot, who confers upon you the privilege of learning Master Chef II. Is this a nummier version of Master Chef I, you wonder? Dingdingding! You are correct.

emblem_skill_unlock_spriggan_1.name: Spent First Emblem of Spriggan
emblem_skill_unlock_spriggan_1.desc: Gained the ability to learn the verdant arts of Arborology III
emblem_skill_unlock_spriggan_1.statusText: By the power of Spriggan's Watering Can, with this unlocking the verdant inner sanctum of Arborology III now beckons you with its, um, verdancy.

emblem_skill_unlock_ti_1.name: Spent First Emblem of Tii
emblem_skill_unlock_ti_1.desc: Earned the right to learn Intermediate Admixing
emblem_skill_unlock_ti_1.statusText: Unlocking this Emblem of Tii gives you the power to become an intermediate admixer. If you so choose, the coveted skill of Intermediate Admixing can be yours.

emblem_skill_unlock_zille_1.name: Spent First Emblem of Zille
emblem_skill_unlock_zille_1.desc: Gained the power to learn Mining III, the penultimate Mining skill
emblem_skill_unlock_zille_1.statusText: Zounds! By unlocking the First Emblem of Zille, you've earned the privilege of learning Mining III, the penultimate Mining Skill. Unrelated: don't you just love the word penultimate?

enchanting_extractorator.name: Enchanting Extractorator
enchanting_extractorator.statusText: You squooged already powerful herbs into even more powerful concoctions 1009 times. Truly entrancing!

endurance_hi_skipper.name: Endurance Misanthrope
endurance_hi_skipper.desc: Set 547 Daily Records for Hi Sign evasion. Daily Records are recognized at the end of each game day
endurance_hi_skipper.statusText: Sure, they might only have been saying Hi, but that doesn't mean you have to hang around to be Hi'ed. And you haven't: running so fast and so far, you've set 547 daily records for taking social avoidance to new measures. WOO!

entrylevel_admixificator.name: Entry-Level Admixificator
entrylevel_admixificator.desc: Used a Beaker to stir three powders
entrylevel_admixificator.statusText: You and your Beaker are causing quite a stir around these parts. You've earned the status Entry-Level Admixificator.

entrylevel_fruit_tree_harvester.name: Entry-Level Fruit Tree Harvester
entrylevel_fruit_tree_harvester.statusText: We like your pluck. For harvesting 101 pieces of fruit, you've earned the title Entry-Level Fruit Tree Harvester.

epic_blowout.name: Epic Blowout
epic_blowout.desc: Attended a house party containing 11 guests under the influence.
epic_blowout.statusText: Woah. That was a party to remember. Or not, as the case may be. The memories from your Epic Blowout may be hazy, but you know what isn't? This awesome badge. YEAH.

epic_hero.name: Epic Hero
epic_hero.desc: Contributed to each feat in one epic
epic_hero.statusText: Every feat in one epic, you did your bit. It's Glitches like you that ensure the growth of Ur. And that's what makes you both an Epic Hero, and a hero of epic proportions.

epic_poet.name: Epic Poet
epic_poet.desc: Added something to each feat in 3 epics
epic_poet.statusText: Tireless is the tiny glitch who works upon the feat, doing all that must be done, a-pounding every street. Three-epicfuls of feats you did, and that is quite a lot: and that explains why (happily) this badge you have just got. Hurrah!

epic_urian.name: Epic Urian
epic_urian.desc: Pitched in to each feat in 7 epics
epic_urian.statusText: In ancient times, the completion of ones seventh epic of feats is celebrated by an epic feast. In modern Ur, the heaving tables of food are replaced by this Epic Urian badge. Do not eat it.

exceptionally_fine_refiner_blue_class.name: Exceptionally Fine Refiner, Blue Class
exceptionally_fine_refiner_blue_class.statusText: It's elementary, my dear Glitchling. You've refined 10,007 Blue Elements, earning you the title Exceptionally Fine Refiner, Blue Class.

exceptionally_fine_refiner_green_class.name: Exceptionally Fine Refiner, Green Class
exceptionally_fine_refiner_green_class.statusText: Well, it's been quite a grind, but you made it. You've earned the title Exceptionally Fine Refiner, Green Class.

exceptionally_fine_refiner_red_class.name: Exceptionally Fine Refiner, Red Class
exceptionally_fine_refiner_red_class.statusText: For your generally unswerving dedication to the element-smooshing arts, you've earned the designation Exceptionally Fine Refiner.

exceptionally_fine_refiner_shiny_class.name: Exceptionally Fine Refiner, Shiny Class
exceptionally_fine_refiner_shiny_class.statusText: Sure, there is glory in becoming an Exceptionally Fine Refiner, Shiny Class. There is also the risk of Shiny-tosis. Be sure to perform regular self-examinations.

executive_flunky_tinkering_ops.name: Executive Flunky, Tinkering Ops
executive_flunky_tinkering_ops.desc: Wielded a Tinkertool to repair 1009 units worth of tools
executive_flunky_tinkering_ops.statusText: There are jobs, and there are careers. And then there is what you do. Congratulations on successfully tinkering your way to the title Executive Flunky, Tinkering Ops. Remember, you can only go up from here.

executive_in_charge_of_spice_reformatati.name: Executive in Charge of Spice Reformatation
executive_in_charge_of_spice_reformatati.statusText: Sure, Executive In Charge of Spice Reformatation sounds all made-uppy, but it's not. You've made it to the highest echelon of Spicery.

extremely_promising_tree_hugger.name: Extremely Promising Tree Hugger
extremely_promising_tree_hugger.statusText: You like petting Trees. Trees like to be petted. Celebrate this mutually weird relationship with the title Extremely Promising Tree Hugger badge.

famous_featologist.name: Famous Featologist
famous_featologist.statusText: To partake in one feat is good, to partake in a handful is glorious. To partake in 253 is a feat in itself. You, Famous Featologist, have made a feat of feating.

fancy_medal_fancier.name: Fancy Medal Fancier
fancy_medal_fancier.desc: Scrupulously earned 47 Emblems of the Giants
fancy_medal_fancier.statusText: You've scrimped, scrabbled and saved up 47 Emblems of the Giants, hereby earning the title Fancy Medal Fancier. Fancy that.

feat_first.name: Feat First
feat_first.statusText: Your conch blown, you took your chance and played your part. In what? A feat! For why? Because it was there! And now? You got a badge for it! Yay!

feat_of_peat_excellence.name: Feat of Peat Excellence
feat_of_peat_excellence.desc: Harvested 1009 slightly funky Blocks of Peat
feat_of_peat_excellence.statusText: You've just officially harvested your 1009th Block of Peat. Is this a Feat of Peat Excellence or just a random moment? It's both!

feater_of_glory.name: Feater of Glory
feater_of_glory.statusText: Whyfore do we feat? Some feat for fame. Some feat for the good of Ur. Others feat for glory. And there's no shame in that. There are, however, badges. Badges!

featist_of_renown.name: Featist of Renown
featist_of_renown.statusText: Your name is whispered by waving weeds and dancing leaves on streets of Ur that would not have been imagined into creation but for the 53 feats you fot. Bravo!

fecundationist.name: Fecundationist
fecundationist.statusText: Congratulations! This is the 503th weedy patch you've cleaned up. You've achieved Fecundationist status.

fenneq_completist.name: Fenneq Completist
fenneq_completist.statusText: You traversed over all the rocks, and got back up after you tripped on a few. You chased all the foxes, even when you realized you're not a very fast runner. You are a true Fenneq champion and rightfully deserve one of these ultra-special-badge-y-thingies.

fertilivert.name: Fertilivert
fertilivert.desc: Used Fertilidust on 4 Trees at once
fertilivert.statusText: You've just fertilized four Trees at once with your Fertilidust, thereby earning the title of Fertilivert. In the world of trees, this is an honor to wear with pride.

finallyprettygood_tree_hugger.name: Finally-Pretty-Good Tree Hugger
finallyprettygood_tree_hugger.statusText: Despite your mismatched heights, you have excelled in the splintery field of Tree petting. Enjoy your Finally-Pretty-Good Tree Hugger status.

fine_friend.name: Fine Friend
fine_friend.statusText: You're getting pretty popular! You've earned a Fine Friend badge.

fine_mincer.name: Fine Mincer
fine_mincer.desc: Minced, chopped and hacked 23 recipes with a Knife & Board.
fine_mincer.statusText: Chop chop! For your deftitude with a knife and board, you've earned a Fine Mincer badge.

fine_refiner_blue_class.name: Fine Refiner, Blue Class
fine_refiner_blue_class.statusText: We've lost count of the number of Chunks you've delicately pulverized to smitheroons, but we haven't lost count of the number of Blue Elements you've refined: 1009. That deserves a badge or something. Here's a badge. We're all out of something.

fine_refiner_green_class.name: Fine Refiner, Green Class
fine_refiner_green_class.statusText: When you refine a Green Element, it stays refined. And when you refine 1009 Green Elements, you get a title like Fine Refiner, Green Class. Awesome? Yes.

fine_refiner_red_class.name: Fine Refiner, Red Class
fine_refiner_red_class.statusText: If there were a badge for being such a Fine Refiner, surely you would earn it. Oh wait. There is a badge. Here it is. Sorry for the confusion.

fine_refiner_shiny_class.name: Fine Refiner, Shiny Class
fine_refiner_shiny_class.statusText: A steady hand, and an even steadier temper, is required to refine as many Shiny Elements as you have. You have earned the title Fine Refiner, Shiny Class.

firefly_whistling.name: Firefly Whistling
firefly_whistling.statusText: You swallowed that real good and ended up with the ability to whistle whenever you need to summon some Fireflies.

firetongue_award.name: Firetongue Award
firetongue_award.statusText: You just drank 11 Flaming Humbabas. That's going to leave a mark! You get a Firetongue Award.

firozi_completist.name: Firozi Completist
firozi_completist.statusText: Ventured through the whole place, you did! You explored every last inch of Firozi. Wow. It did take you a while though. I used that time to come up with a way to express how awesome you are. In the end, I got nothin'. So here's a shiny badge instead!

first_alph_emblem.name: First Emblem of Alph
first_alph_emblem.statusText: Ah, you are indeed a worthy supplicant.  For all your diligent effort in accumulating 1000 favor points, I bestow upon you the glorious Emblem of Alph.  My debt to you is now paid in full.

first_cosma_emblem.name: First Emblem of Cosma
first_cosma_emblem.statusText: Humble Glitchling, your petitions have pleased me greatly. Or at least they have not displeased me greatly. Either way, as a reward for obtaining 1000 favor points, I confer upon you the noble Emblem of Cosma.

first_eleven_skills.name: First Eleven
first_eleven_skills.desc: Learned your first eleven skills. Awww … so cute.
first_eleven_skills.statusText: Some say the first eleven are the hardest. However, they are wrong: the last eleven are far, far harder. Still: good work!

first_friendly_emblem.name: First Emblem of Friendly
first_friendly_emblem.statusText: Small and modest creature, I accept your deferential offerings. For amassing 1000 favor points, I bid you accept this Emblem of Friendly, which shines with all the radiance of my radiantness.

first_grendaline_emblem.name: First Emblem of Grendaline
first_grendaline_emblem.statusText: Lo, meek one. For granting me the dues I so richly deserve, I have granted you 1000 favor points. And now I guess I will grant you this Emblem of Grendaline. Lo!

first_humbaba_emblem.name: First Emblem of Humbaba
first_humbaba_emblem.statusText: Oho, young seeker. For your persistent efforts to accrue 1000 favor points, I now reward you with... more favor. This time it is in the form of an Emblem of Humbaba. Cherish it.

first_lem_emblem.name: First Emblem of Lem
first_lem_emblem.statusText: The depth of your obsequiousness is matched only by the depth of your pockets. For accumulating 1000 favor points, you are now entitled to receive one shiny Emblem of Lem.

first_mab_emblem.name: First Emblem of Mab
first_mab_emblem.statusText: Your favor-currying has not gone unnoticed. For collecting 1000 favor points, I now bestow upon you an Emblem of Mab, which, conveniently, is the perfect size for tucking under your pillow to dream on at night.

first_pot_emblem.name: First Emblem of Pot
first_pot_emblem.statusText: While your demeanor has not always been as reverent as I would have liked, I cannot disregard the magnitude of your offerings. You have collected 1000 favor points, which entitles you to this token of favor, an honorable Emblem of Pot.

first_series_releaser.name: First Series Releaser
first_series_releaser.desc: Set free one each of the releasable Series 1 Cubimals
first_series_releaser.statusText: There were only so many chicks you could house, so you set them, with some of their little friends, free. How kind you are! For your kindness: a badge.

first_spriggan_emblem.name: First Emblem of Spriggan
first_spriggan_emblem.statusText: Your humble offerings pile around my toes like so many tickly pebbles. I am duly tickled. In exchange for your 1000 favor points, I grant you this Emblem of Spriggan.

first_ti_emblem.name: First Emblem of Tii
first_ti_emblem.statusText: I have tallied your oblations, large and small, tiny one. You have earned 1000 favor points and thus, a spark of my favor. Take this Emblem of Ti in humility.

first_zille_emblem.name: First Emblem of Zille
first_zille_emblem.statusText: Your lowly offerings have charmed me, young meekling. It has amused me to confer upon you 1000 favor points. Now take upon you this Emblem of Zille. Bear it wisely and well.

firstbest_bubble_farmer.name: First-Best Bubble Farmer
firstbest_bubble_farmer.statusText: Glory of glories, you are now a First-Best Bubble Farmer! Go ahead and let that go to your head.

firstrate_rainmaker.name: First-Rate Rainmaker
firstrate_rainmaker.statusText: You're a one-person sprinkler system! You've been promoted to First-Rate Rainmaker.

five_feat_under.name: Five Feat Under
five_feat_under.statusText: Five feats would have been that little less featy had you not feated. But feat you did, and, with Five Feats Under your belt, you earned yourself one shiny badge too. Coo!

fledgling_crest_collector.name: Fledgling Crest Collector
fledgling_crest_collector.desc: Earnestly earned 5 Emblems of the Giants
fledgling_crest_collector.statusText: Five Emblems of the Giants isn't much of a collection, but hey, everyone has to start somewhere. You may now officially consider yourself a Fledgling Crest Collector.

fleet_foxer.name: Fleet Foxer
fleet_foxer.desc: Brushed the same fox 3 times in 10 seconds
fleet_foxer.statusText: What's quick like a fox? Well, a fox is. But what else is? You, Fleet Foxer, and your ability to brush the same fox three times in less than ten seconds. A triple-brush!

folivoria_completist.name: Folivoria Completist
folivoria_completist.statusText: Holy sloth-knocker! They said you couldn't do it. Yup, every last one of them said you would never even be able to get close. But, you did it! You explored every cliff top, saw every sloth bandana and in the end you can finally say, "Who's the sloth-knocker now?" And, you get this nifty badge too.

forgey_laforge.name: Forgey LaForge
forgey_laforge.desc: Smelted 41 Metal Ingots from purest Metal Rock
forgey_laforge.statusText: You've used a Smelter to channel the power of raw heat in order to turn Metal Rock into Plain Metal. Like a god, you are. A god named Forgey LaForge.

fox_brushing_license.name: Licensed To Brush Foxes
fox_brushing_license.desc: Congrats! You are now licensed to brush foxes.
fox_brushing_license.statusText: Congrats! You are now licensed to brush foxes.

fox_flurrier.name: Fox Flurrier
fox_flurrier.desc: With 9 Glitches, witnessed the simultaneous presence of three foxes in one location
fox_flurrier.statusText: A flurry of foxes was yours to behold, a number of foxes - three foxes, all told. You witnessed the foxes, and that sure was fun… but now looky here at the badge that you won!

fox_tourist.name: Fox Tourist
fox_tourist.desc: Brushed a fox in preserves in each of the 10 regions
fox_tourist.statusText: Not content with sticking to your local foxes, you made it a mission to brush the tails of foxes in every corner of Ur. Was it worth it? Sure it was, here's a badge! BAM!

framer_ranger.name: Framer Ranger
framer_ranger.statusText: Because any wise glitch knows that a decoration without a frame is just a piece of colourful something thrown at the wall, you made frames. 23 of them, in fact, you Wise little Framer Ranger, you.

friend_of_cubimals.name: Friend of Cubimals
friend_of_cubimals.statusText: 11 Cubimals, grateful for their glorious freedom, sent me to give you this badge. They told me to tell you: "Thank you, Friend."

friend_of_the_urth.name: Friend of the Urth
friend_of_the_urth.statusText: From the dirt packed under your fingernails, the mud in your hair, and the ripe smell of Glitchly sweat emanating from your underpits, everyone knows you are a true Friend of the Urth. Also because you have this badge! Yay!

fruit_metamorphosizin_tycoon.name: Fruit Metamorphosizin' Tycoon
fruit_metamorphosizin_tycoon.statusText: If there was a prize for converting this many fruit, you would deserve it. Oh wait... there is! It's the badge for being a Fruit Metamorphosizin' Tycoon.

full_time_swami.name: Full-Time Swami
full_time_swami.desc: Practiced meditation for a sum total of 251 minutes
full_time_swami.statusText: You've spent a lot of time thinking about nothing. For some people, this would be a bad thing, but as a Full-Time Swami, you know better.

garrulous_prolixificator.name: Garrulous Prolixificator
garrulous_prolixificator.statusText: Your prodigious palaver has just earned you the title Garrulous Prolixificator.

gas_dabbler.name: Gas Dabbler
gas_dabbler.statusText: Successfully converting 53 Gases automatically qualifies you to be a Gas Dabbler, with all the attendant rights and responsibilities of that position.

gas_guzzler.name: Gas Guzzler
gas_guzzler.statusText: You're so in tune with machines, you're ready to refuel before they even splutter to a stop. 23 machines owe you their life. Hats off to you, Gas Guzzler.

gastro_gnome.name: Gastro-gnome
gastro_gnome.statusText: Bon appetit! You're a card-carrying Gastro-gnome.

gastronaut.name: Gastronaut
gastronaut.statusText: Gastronaut might not sound like a sexy title, but your dedication, drive, and can-do approach to converting 2003 gases sure is. Sexy, that is.

generalissimo_beanorator.name: Generalissimo Beanorator
generalissimo_beanorator.statusText: Hear-hear! This marks the 2003rd basic Bean you've seasoned to a fancier state. This makes you nothing less than a Generalissimo Beanorator. This honor, of course, comes with a badge.

gettingthere_tree_hugger.name: Getting-There Tree Hugger
gettingthere_tree_hugger.statusText: You've braved splinters to pet 127 Trees. You've earned the middling glory of being a Getting-There Tree Hugger.

giant_lover.name: Giant Lover
giant_lover.desc: Created an icon for every Giant
giant_lover.statusText: To show one Giant enough love for a single Emblem is good. To show enough love to one Giant for an Icon is great. But to show all eleven Giants enough love to make eleven Icons? Well, that's frankly remarkable. YOU are remarkable, Giant Lover.

giant_snail_lander.name: Giant Snail Lander
giant_snail_lander.statusText: Slowly Slowly catchee snailee, or so they say. And they're right: it took a while but you finally garnered 10009 snails. Hurrah!

girder_herder.name: Girder Herder
girder_herder.statusText: 41 girders look to you and call you daddy. Or mommy. Or whatever word girders use for that kinda thing. Basically, you're as close to a god as you can get in the world of girders. Good on you, Girder Herder!

glitch_train.name: Glitch Train
glitch_train.desc: Participated in a 20-player follow-me parade through 5 locations
glitch_train.statusText: People are always looking down on being a follower. In this case it's good thing. For participating in a multi-player parade, you've just earned your Glitch Train badge!

globetrotter_extraordinaire.name: Globetrotter Extraordinaire
globetrotter_extraordinaire.statusText: You've seen a lot of this crazy old world. Wipe the dust off your feet and enjoy this Globetrotter Extraordinaire badge.

gloopmeister.name: Gloopmeister
gloopmeister.statusText: Scooping up 1009 Jellisacs isn't exactly difficult. It's not like they put up a fight or anything. But still, noteworthy! Consider it duly noted with this coveted Gloopmeister badge.

glop_grappler.name: Glop Grappler
glop_grappler.statusText: This marks the 503rd Jellisac that you've manfully wrangled with your own bare hands. Everyone else wanted to give you a pair of rubber gloves, but I knew that what you really wanted was highly sought-after Glop Grappler badge. You're welcome.

glutton_for_nourishment.name: Glutton for Nourishment
glutton_for_nourishment.statusText: Yumbies! You're a Glutton for Nourishment, and now you have a badge to prove it.

golden_hock_award.name: Golden Hock Award
golden_hock_award.statusText: Good lard! You've wolfed down a lot of meat. You are hereby awarded our highest honor: the coveted Golden Hock Award.

golden_ladle_award.name: Golden Ladle Award
golden_ladle_award.desc: Whipped up 137 meals with an Awesome Pot
golden_ladle_award.statusText: Holy macaroni! You've mastered the Awesome Pot! You win a toothsome Golden Ladle Award.

golden_ovum_award.name: Golden Ovum Award
golden_ovum_award.statusText: For outstanding achievement in the field of egg-cellence, you win a slightly gooey Golden Ovum Award.

golden_shower_award.name: Golden Watering Can
golden_shower_award.statusText: You've just watered your 1,009th plant! You win the highly sought-after Golden Watering Can Award!

goo_getter.name: Goo-Getter
goo_getter.statusText: After scooping up 127 Jellisacs, you're a certified Goo-Getter. While you already have the pruney fingers to prove it, this little badge is nice, too.

good_bubble_farmer.name: Good Bubble Farmer
good_bubble_farmer.statusText: Bloop! Not many people know this, but 'Bloop!' means congratulations in the Bubble Farmer community. Now that you've achieved the level of Good Bubble Farmer, it's crucial that you know this.

good_buddy.name: Good Buddy
good_buddy.statusText: Way to make friends and influence people! You've earned a Good Buddy badge.

good_neighbour.name: Good Neighbour
good_neighbour.statusText: You've added five friends to your signpost. Doesn't that just make you feel warm and fuzzy inside? No? Well, what about this badge? WOO!

gourmand_supreme.name: Gourmand Supreme
gourmand_supreme.statusText: With 1,009 meals under your belt, you've gormandized aplenty. You are hereby awarded the title Gourmand Supreme!

grand_poobah_tinkering_ops.name: Grand Poobah, Tinkering Ops
grand_poobah_tinkering_ops.desc: Wielded a Tinkertool to repair 25013 units worth of tools
grand_poobah_tinkering_ops.statusText: When you've repaired as many tools as you have, they don't just call you Poobah. They call you Grand Poobah. And now you have the badge to prove it.

gravy_maven.name: Gravy Maven
gravy_maven.statusText: You're a saucy one. We like it! You've earned the title Gravy Maven.

grease_monkey.name: Grease Monkey
grease_monkey.desc: Fried up 41 meals with a Frying Pan.
grease_monkey.statusText: When it comes to cooking with a Frying Pan, there aren't many monkeys greasier than you. You've earned a Grease Monkey badge!

gregarious_gunther.name: Gregarious Gunther
gregarious_gunther.statusText: Oh the places you have been, and oh the home streets that you've seen! With feet in your head, and brains in your shoes, you can go wandering wherever you choose! 503 home streets you landed upon. Just look at the pretty badge that you've won!

grill_jockey.name: Grill Jockey
grill_jockey.desc: Delicately charred 23 dishes with a Famous Pugilist Grill.
grill_jockey.statusText: Turn up the heat! You've won the title of Grill Jockey.

groddle_forest_completist.name: Groddle Forest Completist
groddle_forest_completist.desc: Visited every location in Groddle Forest
groddle_forest_completist.statusText: Congratulations! You've rambled every road in Groddle Forest. In lieu of a commemorative spoon, please accept the somewhat dull but honest title Groddle Forest Completist.

groddle_heights_completist.name: Groddle Heights Completist
groddle_heights_completist.desc: Visited every location in Groddle Heights. Including a couple of secret ones.
groddle_heights_completist.statusText: From its tallest crest down to its weirdest crag, to its two most secret crannies, you've explored every last nook of Groddle Heights, with not even a cheap little plastic souvenir cliff to show for it. You do, however, get the title of Groddle Heights Completist. That counts for something, right?

groddle_meadows_completist.name: Groddle Meadow Completist
groddle_meadows_completist.desc: Visited every location in Groddle Meadow
groddle_meadows_completist.statusText: Oh sure, Groddle Meadow may not have the show-offy drama of Groddle Heights or the dramatic views of Alakol. But this green and pleasant land certainly contains a lot of roads, and you've travelled them all. For that you've earned the title Groddle Meadow Completist.

ground_hogger.name: Ground Hogger
ground_hogger.statusText: Your commitment to public transit is noble, civic-minded, and deserves a better reward than this Ground Hogger badge. But there you have it.

gumflapper.name: Gumflapper
gumflapper.statusText: You've got a way with words. You've earned a Gumflapper badge!

h2oh_award.name: H2Oh! Award
h2oh_award.statusText: Oh, oh! You've just earned a slightly sodden H2Oh! Award.

hairball_gonzales.name: Hairball Gonzales
hairball_gonzales.desc: Went further, faster, than ever before
hairball_gonzales.statusText: One minute you were there, next minute: gone. Like a greased hairball zipping through the streets of Ur, you covered 15 planks faster than a speeding bullet. Or "slightly faster than normal", anyway. ¡Arriba! ¡Arriba! ¡Epa! ¡Epa! ¡Epa!

hallowed_be_shrine_name.name: Hallowed Be Shrine Name
hallowed_be_shrine_name.desc: Donated an expensive item to a Shrine under the effects of Extremely Hallowed Shrine Powder
hallowed_be_shrine_name.statusText: Don't think donating an item as pricey as this goes unnoticed. Using the Extremely Hallowed Shrine Powder at the same time has helped you snag the coveted Hallowed Be Shrine Name badge.

ham_hocker.name: Ham Hocker
ham_hocker.statusText: That makes 137 Piggies you've nibbled. Slow down - you'll get gas! This Ham Hocker badge is not merely an honor - it's also a warning to others not to get between you and a Piggy.

hand_of_the_king.name: Hand of the King
hand_of_the_king.statusText: Few can say they've spent longer in presence of the crown than you. Not quite a monarch of the crown-caressment community, having had it for 25013 seconds, you're second only to the supreme ruler. Thou art truly: The Hand of the King.

hanky_splanky.name: Hanky Splanky
hanky_splanky.statusText: You have a hankering for a-splankering. Let your shiny new Hanky Splanky badge serve as a warning to your friends and associates.

haoma_completist.name: Haoma Completist
haoma_completist.statusText: Oh man! Is it ever fun watching you bounce around Haoma like a chicken with a bit too much No-no! I am thoroughly entertained and in the end, that's all that really matters, right? Here's a tip for you good glitch. Enjoy.

happy_foxbrusher.name: Happy Foxbrusher
happy_foxbrusher.desc: Brushed 1009 fibers from the tails of foxes
happy_foxbrusher.statusText: The foxes of Ur have 1009 fewer fibres in their tails thanks to you. And you have this lovely badge, thanks to them. Happy foxbrushing, Happy Foxbrusher! Foxeh!

haraiva_completist.name: Haraiva Completist
