haraiva_completist.statusText: Gasp! You've climbed and leaped your way up the beautiful and jagged, snowy peaks of Skyr- er, I mean Haraiva! Would've been easier with a gravity-defying horse though. Huh? No, of course that was a joke! Everyone knows horses are just a myth!

hardcore_carnivore.name: Hardcore Carnivore
hardcore_carnivore.statusText: Way to munch that meat. We're offally excited to offer you a juicy promotion to Hardcore Carnivore status.

harmony_hound.name: Harmony Hound
harmony_hound.desc: Practiced meditation for a sum total of 101 minutes
harmony_hound.statusText: Om yeah! You've been at one with the Oneness for 101 minutes. We're not quite sure what the phrase Harmony Hound means, but whatever it is, you're it.

haughty_culturist.name: Haughty Culturist
haughty_culturist.statusText: You've given life to multitudes of crops. How many? More numerous than there are stars in the sky. As long as there are only 1012 stars in your sky. Yes, you, Haughty Culturist: 1013 crops call you daddy.

head_honcho.name: Head Honcho
head_honcho.desc: Ranked as top 5 contributors for 503 phases of a project
head_honcho.statusText: When you've been a top contributor on 503 project phases, they should call you the Head Honcho. Which they will. Because now you are.

healthy_img_turnover.name: Healthy iMG turnover
healthy_img_turnover.desc: Got more than 503 iMG per day as a Stipend
healthy_img_turnover.statusText: People came to your homestreet, and while they were there, they used your stuff enough to ensure a Healthy 503 iMG Daily Stipend. And THAT's when good neighbours become good friends.

heavy_metallurgist.name: Heavy Metallurgist
heavy_metallurgist.desc: Professionally rubbed 41 Plain Metal Ingots into Molybdenum
heavy_metallurgist.statusText: When you rub Plain Metal Ingots into Molybdenum for the first time, you can congratulate yourself on a job well done. When you do it 41 times, you can bask in knowledge you've earned the title of Heavy Metallurgist. Not very heavy. But pretty heavy, man.

heavy_petter.name: Heavy Petter
heavy_petter.statusText: You've fogged up the metaphorical car windows with all this Spice Plant petting. You've well and truly earned the title Heavy Petter.

hen_hugger.name: Hen Hugger
hen_hugger.desc: Squoze 11 Chickens in a friendly sorta way.
hen_hugger.statusText: Squeezing Chickens can be addictive. In a good way. This badge tells everyone in the world that you are an honorary Hen Hugger.

hen_hugger_deluxe.name: Hen Hugger Deluxe
hen_hugger_deluxe.desc: Squoze 41 Chickens in a friendly sorta way
hen_hugger_deluxe.statusText: You know what's better than being a Hen Hugger? Being a Hen Hugger Deluxe, which you can only be after squeezing 41 chickens. This badge is for you.

hen_hugger_supremalicious.name: Hen Hugger Supremalicious
hen_hugger_supremalicious.desc: Squoze 137 Chickens in a friendly sorta way
hen_hugger_supremalicious.statusText: Sure, you've squozen 137 chickens, but you didn't do it for the glory - you did it for the love. Which is why the Chickens want you to have this Hen Hugger Supremalicious badge.

hephaestite.name: Hephaestite
hephaestite.desc: Smelted 1009 Metal Ingots from purest Metal Rock
hephaestite.statusText: A-smeltering you did go, a-smeltering you did go, high-ho the derry-o, a-smeltering you did go. We hope you enjoyed this brief lyrical moment, along with your new Hephaestite badge.

hero_of_the_cubimals.name: Hero of the Cubimals
hero_of_the_cubimals.statusText: 53 Cubimals are now breathing free air thanks to you. Sure, they have their freedom, but what do you have? You have a badge! Woohoo!

hi_and_mighty.name: Hi and Mighty
hi_and_mighty.desc: Got a Mega-Hi 17 times in one game day
hi_and_mighty.statusText: You roamed the world, and found 17 Glitches whose Hi Signs magically matched yours. Not only have you found 17 kindred spirits, you've also found yourself a badge. Yay!

hi_as_a_kite.name: Hi Velocity
hi_as_a_kite.desc: Eluded a Hi Sign for 151 seconds
hi_as_a_kite.statusText: If anyone wants to say hi to you, they'd better be quick about it: you're one Hi Velocity glitch, too speedy for casual salutations. You can avoid a Hi Sign for 151 seconds, after all. Antisocial? No! Superfast!

hi_baller.name: Hi Baller
hi_baller.desc: Made friends with a Mega-Hi 13 times over
hi_baller.statusText: When a Glitch meets a Glitch and they have matching Hi Signs, something magical happens. And when that happens 13 times, something else happens. And THAT thing (the second thing) is this thing. It's a badge, Hi Baller! A badge!

hi_flyer.name: Hi Flyer
hi_flyer.desc: Evaded a Hi Sign for 11 seconds
hi_flyer.statusText: They say you can never outrun a Hi Sign, but gosh-darn it if you didn't give it a good try. It got you in the end, but for 11 whole seconds you were free. Free!

hi_priest.name: Hi Priest
hi_priest.statusText: So many like-minded Glitches roaming streets of Ur. And through serendipity or sheer hard graft, you found 79 of them. You're like the Hi Priest of the Mega-Hi. Mega high five!

hi_speed_chase.name: Hi Speed Chase
hi_speed_chase.desc: Avoided a Hi Sign for 61 seconds
hi_speed_chase.statusText: You believe saying Hi is important, but equally believe that nothing in life is satisfying if you haven't had to work for it. And BOY did you make that little Hi Sign work for it. For 61 seconds! Woah there!

hi_velocity.name: The Motorboat
hi_velocity.desc: Outwitted a Hi Sign for 311 seconds
hi_velocity.statusText: You were like two ships that passed in the night. But while the Hi Sign was some kind of tiny friendly freighter, you were some kind of crazy hi-speed motorboat eschewing that happy greeting for 311 seconds. Go you!

high_speed_commingler.name: High Speed Commingler
high_speed_commingler.desc: Blended 23 drinks or sno cones with a Blender.
high_speed_commingler.statusText: Whirrrrrrrrrrr ... fresh juice, appealing beverages, that mechanical wizard of mixing is coming under your spell. For blending 23 drinks you have earned the High Speed Commingler badge.

highest_of_the_hi_skippers.name: The Speedhermit
highest_of_the_hi_skippers.desc: Set an ALL-TIME record in a location for Hi-Sign evasion
highest_of_the_hi_skippers.statusText: Others may have run from social contact, but none ran as fast, or for as long, as you. You fiercely retained your lone wolf status for longer than anyone had ever done in that location before. Keep on keeping on, you rugged Speedhermit, you!

highranking_supplicant.name: High-Ranking Supplicant
highranking_supplicant.statusText: You have officially donated to a plopload of Shrines. Sure, being a supplicant is kind of subservient, but you! You are tops among the subservient. That's got to count for something, right? Contemplate this as you enjoy your new High-Ranking Supplicant badge.

hill_of_beams.name: Hill of Beams
hill_of_beams.statusText: You've made 107 beams. Blimey, that's a bunch of beams. A Hill of Beams in a crazy world. A beam bonanza. Behold: a badge.

hobbyist_gas_fancier.name: Hobbyist Gas Fancier
hobbyist_gas_fancier.statusText: Somewhere between an Occasional Gas Fancier and a Dedicated Gas Fancier is you: a newly anointed Hobbyist Gas Fancier. Different, but not yet weird.

hollow_leg_award.name: Hollow Leg Award
hollow_leg_award.statusText: Salut! You've won the Hollow Leg Award.

homesteader.name: Homesteader
homesteader.desc: Took the big plunge and purchased first home
homesteader.statusText: You've purchased your first home! Your new Homesteader badge comes with a warning: Beware the couch surfer. Also: roof rot.

honourable_chairperson.name: Honourable Chairperson
honourable_chairperson.desc: Crafted one of each type of seating
honourable_chairperson.statusText: Six types of seat and you've crafted them all. That must have been very tiring. Why don't you have a sit down? Not on a chair, of course, that would be ridiculous. Here, have an Honourable Chairperson award. Perhaps you can sit on that?

hoochhawker.name: Hoochhawker
hoochhawker.desc: Determinedly distilled 253 Hooches in your back yard
hoochhawker.statusText: Due to your distillation determination, there are at least 253 more means of getting buzzed in the world than there were before you began. Terviseks!

hoochmeister.name: Hoochmeister
hoochmeister.statusText: Your whistle is thoroughly wetted. Congratulation! You're a bona fide Hoochmeister.

hot_rodmaker.name: Hot Rodmaker
hot_rodmaker.statusText: You turned formless base matter into a sturdy rod of gleaming metal, not once, but 67 times. Which is two less than 69. 69, Dude!

house_party.name: House Party
house_party.desc: Generously hosted 17 guests in your house
house_party.statusText: Who knows how to party? You know how to party: At home, with 17 of your very closest friends. Good times, man, good times.

humble_bragger.name: Humble Bragger
humble_bragger.statusText: Big, shiny and representing the heights of your awesomeness, you've put those 11 trophies on display. Why not? You earned them, why not show them off? Hey: AND this badge! Bonus!

ice_baby.name: Ice Baby
ice_baby.desc: Cooly scraped 67 Ice from Ice Nubbins
ice_baby.statusText: Risking goosepimples and a decidedly chilly undercarriage, you strode into the frozen badlands and scraped 67 Ice from Ice Nubbins. You're a baby in the ice-scraping world, but hey: look at all that ice, Ice Baby!

ice_cruncher.name: Holy Zamboni
ice_cruncher.desc: Gleaned as much iMG as you could from the crunching of ice.
ice_cruncher.statusText: Though every crunch represented a very real possibility of brainfreeze, you battled through and reached the extent of what there is to be learnt from crushing bits of ice into clear, smooth, nothingness. And that's why they call you the Holy Zamboni, eh? Yay!

ice_ice_baby.name: Ice Ice Baby
ice_ice_baby.statusText: Stop! Collaborate and listen! You coolly scraped 227 wild ice from wild ice nubbins. 227 Ice?!? Ice, ICE baby! Woah! Word to your mother!

icebreaker.name: Icebreaker
icebreaker.desc: Scraped free 1777 Ice from Ice Nubbins
icebreaker.statusText: You're proud, confident, you've got a scraper, and you know at least two ways to use it. You're a cool calm Icebreaker: and precisely the kind of person everyone wants at parties. YEAH.

ilmenskie_caverns_completist.name: Ilmenskie Caverns Completist
ilmenskie_caverns_completist.desc: Visited every location in Ilmenskie Caverns
ilmenskie_caverns_completist.statusText: You've proved you can get down - deep, deep down - by walking every street in Ilmenskie. And by plumbing the depths, you've scaled the heights of title-getting… by getting a title. Arise, Ilmenskie Completist.

ilmenskie_deeps_completist.name: Ilmenskie Deeps Completist
ilmenskie_deeps_completist.desc: Visited every location in Ilmenskie Deeps
ilmenskie_deeps_completist.statusText: You delved deeper than ever thought possible, and by scraping the very undercarriage of Ilmenskie Deeps, you've hit paydirt: the title of Ilmenskie Deeps Completist. Hey! Turns out hitting bottom was a much more rewarding experience than you'd been led to believe!

impossible_achievement.name: The Impossible Achievement
impossible_achievement.desc: This one ... well, you really can't get it.

incubator_par_eggcellence.name: Incubator Par Egg-cellence
incubator_par_eggcellence.desc: Incubated 103 Eggs, with some help from a Chicken
incubator_par_eggcellence.statusText: Wow! That makes 103 Eggs you've hatched, without spilling a single drop of yolk. You deserve the title of Incubator Par Egg-cellence.

inspirational_home_improver.name: Inspirational Home Improver
inspirational_home_improver.statusText: Never one to settle for second best, you upgraded to unique first-best furniture a total of 53 times, and never looked back. For that, you deserve a reward. Take this gorgeous badge, Inspirational Home Improver.

interested_party.name: Interested Party
interested_party.desc: Helped out with 5 phases of a project
interested_party.statusText: You like helping out. We like that you like helping out. We like it so much we're awarding you the title Interested Party. Is it the flashiest title out there? No sir, it is not. But there you go.

intermediate_fruit_metamorphosizer.name: Intermediate Fruit Metamorphosizer
intermediate_fruit_metamorphosizer.statusText: One thing is for sure: all the Cherries you've converted will never be the same. You may now brag to your friends that you are an Intermediate Fruit Metamorphosizer

intermediate_larva_lover.name: Intermediate Larva Lover
intermediate_larva_lover.desc: Fed 23 Caterpillars until they metamorphosized into Butterflies
intermediate_larva_lover.statusText: That makes 23 Caterpillars who would never have matured into milk-giving adulthood without you. You deserve the title Intermediate Larva Lover, and all the honors that title entails.

intermediate_spice_collector.name: Intermediate Spice Collector
intermediate_spice_collector.statusText: You've harvested 503 nostril-pleasing Spices, thereby earning yourself an Intermediate Spice Collector badge, which is, ironically, a collector's item in and of itself.

into_the_light.name: Into the Light
into_the_light.statusText: Who brings light into ordinary lives? You do. Quite literally. For bringing at least 11 glitches Into The Light (of a lamp), take this badge, oh luminous one.

ix_completist.name: Ix Completist
ix_completist.statusText: You've tumbled down the great hole and adventured in every corner of the ancient wonderland of Ix, traversing every Spice, from West to East (or East to West, if you are that way inclined) until you earned the title Ix Completist. Which you did. Go you!

jal_completist.name: Jal Completist
jal_completist.statusText: Don't forget to bring a towel! Oh, too late it seems. Well, don't you hate when you get water up your nose? I wouldn't know since I don't have one, but I hear it's the worst. Next to stubbing your toe of course. I can't do that either, but you can! You can also swim through all of Jal it seems. As such, I got you this somewhat water proof badge!

jammy_dodger.name: Jammy Dodger
jammy_dodger.statusText: You ducked, you dived, you jumped and you ran like the wind, artfully outsmarting 137 Juju Bandits. You jammy little Juju-dodger, you.

jethimadh_completist.name: Jethimadh Completist
jethimadh_completist.statusText: You've circled the great tower of Jethimadh on foot, and gazed upon its dizzying heights from every conceivable angle, and you're still not sure how high it goes. But one thing is sure: You're now a Jethimadh Completist.

jiggers_ribbon.name: Jigger's Ribbon
jiggers_ribbon.statusText: A badge named after the ribbon awarded to 'A. Jigger' who listed the staggering number of potions he made (199 in all) in his Potion Opuscule (some kind of book). Hey! 199 Potions! Thats just like you!

johnny_anyseed.name: Johnny Anyseed
johnny_anyseed.statusText: You've spilled your beans far and wide. You've earned the title Johnny Anyseed.

jolly_good_chap.name: Jolly Good Chap
jolly_good_chap.statusText: There's just something about you that people like. Here's a Jolly Good Chap badge.

junior_dough_puncher.name: Junior Dough Puncher
junior_dough_puncher.statusText: You've decocted even more concoctions! Here's a Junior Dough Puncher badge.

junior_irrigationist.name: Junior Irrigationist
junior_irrigationist.statusText: A wet Egg Plant is a happy Egg Plant. Unless it's too wet. For maintaining optimal wetness on 11 Egg Plants, you've earned the title Junior Irrigationist.

junior_ok_explorer.name: Junior OK Explorer
junior_ok_explorer.statusText: Hey! You're getting pretty good at finding your way around. You've earned a Junior OK Explorer badge.

kajuu_completist.name: Kajuu Completist
kajuu_completist.statusText: You've traversed every road, through those sinister pointy-up bits and pointy-down bits of Kajuu caverns, and emerged, blinking into the half light with a brand new title: that of Kajuu Completist. StalacTITE, dude!

kalavana_completist.name: Kalavana Completist
kalavana_completist.statusText: You delved the depths of Kalavanan firebogginess and plodded down every murky strip: WOO! You've been awarded the title Kalavana Completist. Not many Glitches can say that. Apart from the other ones who have. They also can.

karnata_completist.name: Karnata Completist
karnata_completist.statusText: You wandered around all the cliffs and ledges that beautiful Karnata has to offer. So, what did you get? The pure satisfaction of self accomplishment is all you need! Yup, just the rewarding feeling of reaching a goal. No material goods needed. The experience is enough to satiate the longing for any sort of reward. Just that, and this awesome badge, of course.

killer_griller.name: Killer Griller
killer_griller.desc: Delicately charred 79 dishes with a Famous Pugilist Grill.
killer_griller.statusText: Is it getting hot in here or what? You've earned one Killer Griller badge, fresh off the grill.

kingslayer.name: Kingslayer
kingslayer.statusText: Do peasants tremble as you pass? Probably because they've heard of your meteoric rise through the ranks, laying waste to all around you, and holding the crown for a mighty 12007 seconds. Thou dost truly deserve the name: Kingslayer.

kloro_completist.name: Kloro Completist
kloro_completist.statusText: Amidst the eerie night sky, you hopped, skipped, and jumped your way across the uneven features of Kloro. Accept this badge as not only for your adventuring prowess, but also your wicked parkour skills.

knight_of_the_kingsguard.name: Knight of the Kingsguard
knight_of_the_kingsguard.statusText: While others fought to get a grip, you manhandled that metal hat firmly for 5003 whole seconds. Valiant? Perhaps. Chivalous? Whatever: you've fondled the crown for 5003 seconds: that alone makes you Knight of the Kingsguard.

landgrabber.name: Landgrabber
landgrabber.desc: Expanded your home street and yard to their full widths
landgrabber.statusText: BAM! You've reached out in every direction, and your domain - front and back - couldn't be bigger. Brava, Landgrabber! Enjoy your personal kingdom AND your badge.

lanternerer.name: Lanternerer
lanternerer.desc: Lit and Displayed a Pumpkin Lantern
lanternerer.statusText: You brought the holiday into your heart and displayed it proudly outside or inside your home (the holiday, not your heart, that would be gross). For your dedication to lanterns and lanterning, you get this Lanternerer badge.

leapist.name: Leapist
leapist.statusText: Congratulations. You are now a board-certified Leapist. With springs in your feet and a song in your heart, there isn't much that can keep you down. Except maybe an anvil.

libation_lover.name: Libation Lover
libation_lover.statusText: Sorcerers whisper your name in awe. Wizards have pictures of you in their lockers. You've poured down 353 Potions, and lived to tell the tale. Which tale? The tale of how amazing you are, of course. BAM!

libatious_borage_award.name: Libatious Borage Award
libatious_borage_award.statusText: Potionmaking? You literally wrote the book on potionmaking! Well, not *literally*, but you deserve the award in the name of the a man who did because you? You made a LOT of potions. 1033 in fact. Yowza.

licenced_teleporter_pfft_class.name: Licensed Teleporter (Pfft Class)
licenced_teleporter_pfft_class.desc: Amazingly, attracted followers for 127 practically pain-free teleports
licenced_teleporter_pfft_class.statusText: Teleportation is a really handy way to get yourself and other players from Point A to Point Q. The convenience pretty much makes the side effects worthwhile. Celebrate your nonchalant attitude toward particle displacement with your promotion to Licensed Teleporter, Pfft Class.

licenced_teleporter_whoa_class.name: Licensed Teleporter (Whoa Class)
licenced_teleporter_whoa_class.desc: Teleported 503 times while towing hapless followers
licenced_teleporter_whoa_class.statusText: This marks the 503rd time you've successfully teleported with one or more players. Do you have any idea how many particles that is? 90 trillion times a thousand? Something like that.

licensed_super_gragarious_glitch_beamer.name: Licensed Super-Gregarious Glitch-Beamer
licensed_super_gragarious_glitch_beamer.desc: Somehow convinced 11 or more foolhardy souls to follow on 13 teleports
licensed_super_gragarious_glitch_beamer.statusText: Congratulations! By convincing 11 fellow travellers on the cosmic road to teleport with you a full 13 times, you've finally gained your metaphorical teleportation licence. Technically, you don't actually need a license to teleport, but doesn't having one make you feel special?

licensed_teleporter_gee_class.name: Licensed Teleporter (Gee Class)
licensed_teleporter_gee_class.desc: Convinced 5 or more suckers, er, players to follow on 41 teleports
licensed_teleporter_gee_class.statusText: Teleporting other players is a sacred bond of trust. Namely, they trust that you're going to make sure all their bits come through intact. You've just been promoted to Licensed Teleporter, Gee Class.

lida_completist.name: Lida Completist
lida_completist.statusText: What's green and pleasant and meadowy, has some uppy-downy bits, and is a region you happen to have explored every corner of? Yes! Lida. And to prove it, here's your Lida Completist Badge. You're welcome.

little_squirt.name: Little Squirt
little_squirt.desc: Meticulously watered 11 gaspingly hot Gas Plants
little_squirt.statusText: Because of you and your Watering Can, 11 Gas Plants are no longer quite so hot. This Little Squirt badge is just for you.

loamist.name: Loamist
loamist.desc: Used a Shovel 127 times to dig Patches or Dirt Piles
loamist.statusText: This makes 127 Patches or Dirt Piles you've dug. Celebrate this unearthly experience with this here Loamist badge.

local_yolkel.name: Local Yolkel
local_yolkel.statusText: You're more than a mite peckish. You've achieved Local Yolkel status.

loggerator.name: Loggerator
loggerator.desc: Used a Hatchet to gently harvest Planks from Wood Trees 151 times
loggerator.statusText: If we told you trees felt pain, would you feel guilty for hacking off planks from poor buggers 151 times? I mean, they don't, they love it, but would you? And if you did, would it make you feel better to know that you've achieved title of "Loggerator"? Well, you have!

loneliness_of_the_long_distance_cubimal.name: The Loneliness of the Long Distance Cubimal
loneliness_of_the_long_distance_cubimal.desc: Raced a cubimal to an astounding 8.9 planks
loneliness_of_the_long_distance_cubimal.statusText: It's hard for the long distance cubimal, pounding the ground, step after gruelling tiny step, nothing but the sound of your whirring clockwork innards for company, striving to reach the mystical marathon distance of 8.9 planks. Finally, you did it! Well, your cubimal did. But they're your cubimal: yay YOU!

long_distance_hi_skipper.name: Long-Distance Lone Wolf
long_distance_hi_skipper.desc: Set 137 Daily Records for Hi Sign evasion. Daily Records are recognized at the end of each game day
long_distance_hi_skipper.statusText: You keep running, running and running, running and running, running and running, running. Away from hi-signs, mainly: or enough times to set 137 daily records for Hi Sign evasion, anyway. Run on, Lone Wolf.

lovable_skinflint.name: Lovable Skinflint
lovable_skinflint.statusText: 11,111 currants … that's a lot of ones! Yet, there are many things still which you are unable to afford. Keep on flintin' that skin.

loyal_alloyer.name: Loyal Alloyer
loyal_alloyer.desc: Stewed 5011 compounds with a Test Tube
loyal_alloyer.statusText: Whoa there. That Test Tube cannot take much more concocting. Give that thing a break and enjoy your shiny new Loyal Alloyer badge.

loyal_tender.name: Loyal Tender
loyal_tender.desc: Wore out and restored the same cultivated thing 5 times
loyal_tender.statusText: Far be it from you to let one of your cultivation projects die. You'd rather restore the same thing 5 times over than let it die. Oh wait: you did! For your loyalty: a badge!

lumber_lover.name: Lumber Lover
lumber_lover.desc: Petted and watered 41 Wood Trees to the full woody bloom of adulthood
lumber_lover.statusText: Watering and petting 41 trees to maturity has earned you the title of Lumber Lover. Who has greater love for the nourishment and gentle fondling of a tall, proud piece of woody goodness than you, Tiny Glitch? No one. Your grandmother would be proud. If you had one.

mad_gasser.name: Mad Gasser
mad_gasser.desc: Futzed around with each kind of gas
mad_gasser.statusText: Gases are unpredictable, but you've sniffed, shaken and smashed your way through a lot of them. You deserve this Mad Gasser badge.

major_player.name: Major Player
major_player.desc: Played Glitch for a sweetly life-affirming 11 hours
major_player.statusText: You're still here! It's our favorite thing about you. Honor your stick-to-it-iveness with the title Major Player.

major_tricksy_treater.name: Major Tricksy-Treater
major_tricksy_treater.desc: Gave Candy to 103 Lucky Candy-Biters during Zilloween
major_tricksy_treater.statusText: Apparently, some glitches were never warned about taking candy from strangers. At least 103, in fact, have deemed you non-strange enough to take candy from. What do they know, right?…

make_a_crab_happy.name: Make a Crab Happy
make_a_crab_happy.desc: Played the exact Music Block for the Crab, which he has heard the LEAST recently.
make_a_crab_happy.statusText: Now that's what we call a moldy oldie. For throwing down a sets of claw-snappin' beats that brought the Crab back sweet memories, you've just earned the ever-so-rare Make a Crab Happy award.

make_do_and_mender.name: Make Do and Mender
make_do_and_mender.statusText: Throwaway consumer culturist? You? No: you've restored a whole 53 of them, so they can continue giving up their harvests. AND: this badge. HECKES YEAH!

maniacal_foxbrusher.name: Maniacal Foxbrusher
maniacal_foxbrusher.desc: Brushed 50,003 fibers from the tails of foxes
maniacal_foxbrusher.statusText: It is a wonder that the foxes of Ur aren't wandering the preserves with thrashing bald whips for tails, so many fibers have you brushed. 50,003!?! You deserve this badge, Maniacal Foxbrusher!

massadoe_completist.name: Massadoe Completist
massadoe_completist.statusText: Wow, It's foggy down here! I almost didn't see you step in that guano back there. But guess what? The batterflies tell me you've been to everywhere there is to be in Massadoe! That, my friend, is something to be rewarded for. Maybe use this reward to buy some new shoes huh?

master_bean_counter.name: Master Bean Counter
master_bean_counter.statusText: Now that you've achieved the title of Master Bean Counter, you will know what respect is. You won't necessarily receive it, but you'll know it.

master_blaster.name: Master Blaster
master_blaster.statusText: Eureka! You've dug for ore many times, earning yourself the rather impressive title of Master Blaster.

master_carbonifier.name: Master Carbonifier
master_carbonifier.desc: Delicately charred 41 dishes with a Famous Pugilist Grill.
master_carbonifier.statusText: Delicately charred on the outside, raw in the middle. That deserves a Master Carbonifier badge!

master_furniturererer.name: Master Furniturererer
master_furniturererer.statusText: Furniture trooper to the end, 251 pieces of furniture bear your stamp (and drops of your very own blood, sweat and tears). Here, take this badge, and have a nice lie down. Not on the furniture though. No no no.

master_lepidopteral_manipulator.name: Master Lepidopteral Manipulator
master_lepidopteral_manipulator.statusText: That makes 137 Butterflies you've authoritatively kneaded into momentary submission. Revel in your power! And enjoy your newly earned title of Master Lepidopteral Manipulator.

master_of_internal_emptiness.name: Master of Internal Emptiness
master_of_internal_emptiness.desc: Practiced meditation for a sum total of 503 minutes
master_of_internal_emptiness.statusText: Boo-ya! Who's the serenest? You are, and you have the Master of Internal Emptiness badge to prove it. In your face, Swami Jeff!

master_of_the_hi_coup.name: Master of the Hi Coup
master_of_the_hi_coup.statusText: It's nice to say Hi. And with all these matching signs, you got a new badge!

master_overlord_of_the_spice_dominion.name: Master Overlord of the Spice Dominion
master_overlord_of_the_spice_dominion.statusText: For harvesting 5003 olfactorily satisfying Spices, you've earned the title Master Overlord of the Spice Dominion, which is all kinds of awesome. Say it out loud. See?

master_whacker.name: Master Whacker
master_whacker.desc: Minced, chopped and hacked 137 recipes with a Knife & Board.
master_whacker.statusText: Nobody wields a blade like you. You're a knife and board-certified Master Whacker!

masterful_fruit_tree_pettifier.name: Masterful Fruit Tree Pettifier
masterful_fruit_tree_pettifier.statusText: When it comes to pettifying, you leave no leaf unturned or fruit unfondled. You've earned the title Masterful Fruit Tree Pettifier.

mayor_of_sprayerville.name: Mayor of Sprayerville
mayor_of_sprayerville.desc: Meticulously watered 127 gaspingly hot Gas Plants
mayor_of_sprayerville.statusText: For your generous watering efforts, the grateful Gas Plants have unanimously elected you Mayor of Sprayerville. As Sprayerville is not a real place, this title carries very little political clout.

mediocre_mixologist.name: Mediocre Mixologist
mediocre_mixologist.desc: Crafted 11 cocktails with a Cocktail Shaker.
mediocre_mixologist.statusText: Having crafted 11 cocktails with a Cocktail Shaker, you are now able to pass yourself off as a Mediocre Mixologist. Good job.

member_of_hi_society.name: Member of Hi Society
member_of_hi_society.desc: Greeted players with all 11 Hi Sign variations
member_of_hi_society.statusText: Hearts, flowers, butterflies and bats, you can't remember which was your favourite of the little Hi Signs, but, having seen them all, you're at least in a good position to think about it. AND to get a badge for it. Hurrah!

metal_masseuse.name: Metal Masseuse
metal_masseuse.desc: Smelted 283 Metal Ingots from purest Metal Rock
metal_masseuse.statusText: You may not consider employing your smelter a matter of massage, but smelt Metal Rocks into 283 ingots, and we award you a Metal Masseuse badge.

metalhead.name: Metalhead
metalhead.desc: Smelted 503 Metal Ingots from purest Metal Rock
metalhead.statusText: Yes, you've smelted a lot of Metal Rock into Plain Metal. Yes, we're giving you a badge. Yes, it's the Metalhead badge. Yes!

middling_mixologist.name: Middling Mixologist
middling_mixologist.desc: Crafted 23 cocktails with a Cocktail Shaker.
middling_mixologist.statusText: Sort of takes you back to your first time adding two juices, doesn't it? Now that you have crafted 23 cocktails with a Cocktail Shaker, you are certainly, at least, a Middling Mixologist.

middling_tinsmitherer.name: Middling Tinsmitherer
middling_tinsmitherer.desc: Lovingly rubbed 137 basic Plain Metal Ingots into superior Tin
middling_tinsmitherer.statusText: Well, shiver my tinsnips. Put down those Alchemical Tongs for a little old minute and give yourself a pat on the back. You've just rubbed your 137th Plain Ingot into Tin, and you've done gone and earned yourself the title Middling Tinsmith.

midlevel_admixificator.name: Mid-Level Admixificator
midlevel_admixificator.desc: Used a Beaker to stir 11 powders
midlevel_admixificator.statusText: That was a stirring act of admixificating. For that, you've earned the glorious and noble title of Mid-Level Admixificator.

midlevel_bubble_tree_cuddler.name: Mid-Level Bubble Tree Cuddler
midlevel_bubble_tree_cuddler.statusText: Bubble Trees aren't particular about who cuddles them. Lucky for you, else you might not otherwise have achieved your new status as a Mid-Level Bubble Tree Cuddler.

midmanagement_fruit_tree_harvester.name: Mid-Management Fruit Tree Harvester
midmanagement_fruit_tree_harvester.statusText: You've plucked your way to the level of Mid-Management Fruit Tree Harvesters. Time to go moderately mad with your moderate amount of power.

mighty_fine_mulcher.name: Mighty Fine Mulcher
mighty_fine_mulcher.statusText: You're not afraid to get your hands dirty. You deserve a Mighty Fine Mulcher badge!

mini_tricksy_treater.name: Mini Tricksy-Treater
mini_tricksy_treater.desc: Gave Candy to 5 Lucky Candy-Munchers during Zilloween
mini_tricksy_treater.statusText: In giving candy away to five happy candy-eaters, you're truly the embodiment of the spirit of the holiday. Which holiday? Who CARES! It's candy!

minor_refiner_blue_class.name: Minor Refiner, Blue Class
minor_refiner_blue_class.statusText: You can't refine Blue Elements without crushing a few Chunks. And you can't refine 251 Blue Elements without earning a new badge: Minor Refiner, Blue Class. Them's the rules.

minor_refiner_green_class.name: Minor Refiner, Green Class
minor_refiner_green_class.statusText: Refiner? But you hardly even know her. For enduring that joke, and for refining 251 Green Elements, you have earned the title Minor Refiner, Green Class.

minor_refiner_red_class.name: Minor Refiner, Red Class
minor_refiner_red_class.statusText: You have refined 251 Red Elements to their finest particulate. This may not earn you the adulation of your peers, but it does earn you the title Minor Refiner, Red class.

minor_refiner_shiny_class.name: Minor Refiner, Shiny Class
minor_refiner_shiny_class.statusText: What's better than a Shiny Element? Why, 251 Shiny Elements, of course. For your refining efforts, you've earned yourself the title of Minor Refiner, Shiny Class.

minor_tricksy_treater.name: Minor Tricksy-Treater
minor_tricksy_treater.desc: Gave Candy to 37 Lucky Candy-Eaters during Zilloween
minor_tricksy_treater.statusText: Candyglitch Candyglitch Candygli… No, wait. Apparently something bad happens if I do that. Congrats on the title, though. You're certainly one generous Candyglitch. OH! WHOOPS!

mixed_herbalist.name: Mixed Herbalist
mixed_herbalist.statusText: Oh Herby Day! You've sown 37 precious herby bundles. A badge for all your hoe-ed work.

monarch_of_the_seven_kingdoms.name: Monarch of the Seven Kingdoms
monarch_of_the_seven_kingdoms.statusText: It's unclear which seven kingdoms are being referred to here, unless they include Jumpiland and Platformia. But whatever: against all odds, you've hung on to the crown for 100003 seconds - just crown yourself monarch and have done with it. Huzzah!

moneybags.name: Moneybags
moneybags.statusText: Over 5,011 currants?! You are well on your way to being a person of considerable financial heft. Keep going.

moneybags_magoo.name: Moneybags Magoo
moneybags_magoo.desc: Made a purchase worth 5003 or more currants
moneybags_magoo.statusText: When you spend as many currants as you just did, they call you Moneybags Magoo. And just so you don't forget it, here's a badge.

moonshiner.name: Moonshiner
moonshiner.desc: Delightedly distilled 11 Hooches in your back yard
moonshiner.statusText: Once, alcohol creation was beyond you, now, you are a bubbling wellspring of booziness. You've now made 11 handcrafted Hooches, to sell, give away or, well, drink… Salud!

moste_potente_potioning_medal.name: Moste Potente Potioning Medal
moste_potente_potioning_medal.statusText: Whisperer of the magical elements, amateur cauldron wrangler, tickler of the underside of the Dark Arts: you have entered the portal of Potionmaking (to the tune of 11). May you never look back!

mulcher.name: Mulcher
mulcher.statusText: Oho! You're getting pretty handy with that hoe. You've earned a Mulcher badge.

multi_cultivator.name: Multi Cultivator
multi_cultivator.statusText: Without you, there'd be 503 less clusters of herbs in this world. And without those 503 herby clusters, you'd be without this badge. See? Everyone's a winner.

muufo_completist.name: Muufo Completist
muufo_completist.statusText: Conquerer of every majestic mountain crag and fair foothill, the ancient people of the region would have called you Muufokerologist. But that was deemed a ridiculous name, and instead you've earned the right to brag to anyone who'll listen that you bear the title "Muufo Completist".

naraka_completist.name: Naraka Completist
naraka_completist.statusText: Many claim they've been to hell and back, er …  "Naraka" and back, but how many took in the sights while they were there? Not many. But you did. You roamed the fiery pits and came away with a heightened sense of your own mortality… and this lovely badge. Yay!

necromonger.name: Necromonger
necromonger.statusText: This dying thing is turning into a bad habit. You've earned a Necromonger badge.

nervous_belch_award.name: Nervous Belch Award
nervous_belch_award.statusText: Smoothie? That was more like a bumpy! Distract yourself from the meaty aftertaste with a Nervous Belch Award.

newbie_fruit_tree_pettifier.name: Newbie Fruit Tree Pettifier
newbie_fruit_tree_pettifier.statusText: Celebrate your graduation from the fumblethumbs stage of Fruit Tree petting with a Newbie Fruit Tree Pettifier badge.

nice_dicer.name: Nice Dicer
nice_dicer.desc: Minced, chopped and hacked 41 recipes with a Knife & Board.
nice_dicer.statusText: Nice dicing! You are hereby awarded the title Nice Dicer.

nighmystical_lepidopteral_manipulator.name: Nigh-Mystical Lepidopteral Manipulator
nighmystical_lepidopteral_manipulator.statusText: Long have the Butterflies whispered of One who would administer 503 mystical massages. Lo! It probably isn't you, but you at least deserve the title Nigh-Mystical Lepidopteral Manipulator. Verily!

noble_philanthropizer.name: Noble Philanthropizer
noble_philanthropizer.statusText: You give and give and it never hurts. You've achieved Noble Philanthropizer status.

noisebringer.name: Noise-Bringer
noisebringer.statusText: For rocking the sloth, an unconvincing air guitar salute to you, Noise-Bringer: Widdly-widdly-widdy-widdly-weeee! You brought the noise! Have a badge!

noted_epicure.name: Noted Epicure
noted_epicure.statusText: You just ate your 503rd meal. All hail the glorification of calorification! You've just earned the Noted Epicure badge.

notquitepro_bean_tree_fondler.name: Not-Quite-Pro Bean Tree Fondler
notquitepro_bean_tree_fondler.statusText: So you like to fondle Bean Trees. There's a badge for that. It's the Not-Quite-Pro Bean Tree Fondler badge. Bear it with pride.

notsogrim_reaper.name: Not-So-Grim Reaper
notsogrim_reaper.statusText: Oh my sod! Your nigh-perfect croppification skills have earned you a Not-So-Grim Reaper badge.

nottis_completist.name: Nottis Completist
nottis_completist.statusText: Wow, it's nipply out here. Like being inside a freezer. Yet you still managed to trek through days and nights of slipping on ice and rolling in snow and I present you this badge for your Brrrr-iliant work! Try not to get your tongue stuck on it.

nouveau_whack_job.name: Nouveau Whack Job
nouveau_whack_job.desc: Used a Hatchet to clear 11 dead Trees
nouveau_whack_job.statusText: Now that's some mighty nice tree clearing. You've just earned the title Nouveau Whack Job.

novice_fruit_metamorphosizer.name: Novice Fruit Metamorphosizer
novice_fruit_metamorphosizer.statusText: Bravo for you and your newfound passion for helping Cherries find meaningful life as other fruits. You are now a Novice Fruit Metamorphosizer.

novice_furniturer.name: Novice Furniturer
novice_furniturer.statusText: Tirelessly, you toiled to create 37 pieces of furniture. Have yourself a nice cup of tea and a biscuit. And a badge. Here's your badge.

novice_novitiate.name: Novice Novitiate
novice_novitiate.statusText: Now you're getting the hang of this donating-to-Shrines business. We were going to send you a tax-deductible receipt, but then we decided to give you this Novice Novitiate badge instead. You're welcome.

novice_precipitator.name: Novice Precipitator
novice_precipitator.statusText: You wield a mean watering can! You've earned a Novice Precipitator badge.

novice_spice_collector.name: Novice Spice Collector
novice_spice_collector.statusText: Spice, they say, is the spice of life. As a Novice Spice Collector, you are now traveling a path to greater understanding of this absurd and possibly meaningless saying.

numismatizer_dragon_class.name: Numismatizer, Dragon Class
numismatizer_dragon_class.desc: Collected 100 quoins a day for 17 game days in a row
numismatizer_dragon_class.statusText: There's a fine line between quoin collecting and quoin hoarding, and you've danced across that line with the graceful abandon of a nimble young dragon. Hence your newly earned title: Numismatizer, Dragon Class.

numismatizer_gryphon_class.name: Numismatizer, Gryphon Class
numismatizer_gryphon_class.desc: Collected 100 quoins a day for 11 game days in a row
numismatizer_gryphon_class.statusText: You've picked up 100 quoins a day for 11 game days running. You should probably receive a higher Quoin Multiplier for this achievement. But instead we're going to give you the glorious title Numizmatizer, Gryphon Class.

numismatizer_leprechaun_class.name: Numismatizer, Leprechaun Class
numismatizer_leprechaun_class.desc: Collected 100 quoins a day for 5 game days in a row
numismatizer_leprechaun_class.statusText: Whoa-hoa! You've picked up 100 quoins for 5 days in a row now. You've earned the title Numismatizer, Leprechaun Class.

obsessive_compulsive_re_peater.name: Obsessive-Compulsive Re-Peater
obsessive_compulsive_re_peater.desc: Harvested 503 slightly funky Blocks of Peat
obsessive_compulsive_re_peater.statusText: To some, Blocks of Peat are mere resources necessary for the construction of useful things. For others, they are secret objects of obsessive desire. We're not saying which camp you fall into when we dub you Obsessive-Compulsive Re-Peater. Just making a suggestion.

obsessive_gas_fancier.name: Obsessive Gas Fancier
obsessive_gas_fancier.statusText: After harvesting 5003 Vapors, clearly you're into Gas. Maybe more than would be considered normal. But hey, no judging here. Nope. You go ahead and enjoy this Obsessive Gas Fancier badge.

occasional_gas_fancier.name: Occasional Gas Fancier
occasional_gas_fancier.statusText: Congasulations! You are now an Occasional Gas Fancier. Will you go on to harvest more gases? Or will you rest on your laurels? Or possibly someone else's laurels?

odd_jobber.name: Odd Jobber
odd_jobber.desc: Ranked as top 5 contributors for 11 phases of a project
odd_jobber.statusText: There's no job too odd for you. For ranking among the top 5 contributors in eleven phases of a project, you've fully earned the sought-after Odd Jobber badge.

ok_hewer.name: OK Hewer
ok_hewer.statusText: Here's some news that will tickle your callouses: for your efforts with a pick, you've just earned the designation OK Hewer.

ok_soaker.name: OK Soaker
ok_soaker.statusText: Nothing sadder than a parched Fruit Tree. Good on you for watering the poor little buggers. You've been awarded the title OK Soaker.

okbutneedsimprovement_tree_hugger.name: OK-But-Needs-Improvement Tree Hugger
okbutneedsimprovement_tree_hugger.statusText: That's some all-right Tree petting. You've just earned an OK-But-Needs-Improvement Tree Hugger badge.

on_thin_ice.name: On Thin Ice
on_thin_ice.statusText: You've endured the cold, the stress, the chilblains and the chilly ears, and in scraping these latest few cubical ice lumps, you've earned a badge for 467 over time. Yes. Today was a good day.

order_of_the_butterfly_passant.name: Order of the Butterfly Passant
order_of_the_butterfly_passant.statusText: In Urish days of old, 5 wins gained a knight access to the Order of the Butterfly Passant. Or 'Walking Butterfly' Or 'The Easily-Squishable Club', as bigger, tougher knights called it. Contenders thought this the first step on the way to higher orders… as should you, brave knightling! Onward!

order_of_the_chicken_dormant.name: Order of the Chicken Dormant
order_of_the_chicken_dormant.statusText: How rare is a sleeping chicken? As rare as a challenger that can win 43 games in a row. That's what knights of the Order of the Chicken Dormant believe: and that's why they're proud to call you sibling, and gather you into their feathery midst.

order_of_the_dragon_sejant.name: Order of the Dragon Sejant
order_of_the_dragon_sejant.statusText: When knights or Ur played Game of Crowns to decide rank, Dragons were thought as mythical and as awesome as someone who could win 107 games. You are that mythical, and that awesome. The Order of the Dragon Sejant bids you welcome.

order_of_the_hoarder.name: Order of the Hoarder
order_of_the_hoarder.statusText: With your 211 magnificently crafted Storage Display Boxes, you have truly joined - if not founded - the Order of the Hoarder. Take your commemorative badge, and display it with pride.

order_of_the_manatee_rampant.name: Order of the Manatee Rampant
order_of_the_manatee_rampant.statusText: Nothing terrified novice knights of Ur more than the flag of The Order of the Manatee Rampant, with its flag depicting a giant angry seacow standing proud and victorious over the defeated combatants of 503 Games of Crowns. That flag is now yours. Huzzah!!!

order_of_the_rearing_piggy.name: Order of the Rearing Piggy
order_of_the_rearing_piggy.statusText: In days of yore, in Ur, when the Game of Crowns was used to determine knightly battles of honor, an order was formed representing the animal spirit of those who won 11 whole games. It still exists. Welcome to the Order of the Rearing Piggy. Rowr! Oink!

order_of_the_seventh_seal.name: Order of the Seventh Seal
order_of_the_seventh_seal.desc: Ranked among the top contributors for 7 feats
order_of_the_seventh_seal.statusText: Named after an ancient sea mammal who was particularly fond of high-level participation in feats, you have been awarded the Order of the Seventh Seal. Kudos, seven-time top contributor.

order_of_the_third_otter.name: Order of the Third Otter
order_of_the_third_otter.desc: Ranked among the top contributors for 3 feats
order_of_the_third_otter.statusText: Truly, you belong to the Order of the Third Otter: a small, select group of feat-farers who have fought their way to the top of three contributor tables. Huzzah!

order_of_the_unicorn_salient.name: Order of the Unicorn Salient
order_of_the_unicorn_salient.statusText: People speak in hushed tones of members of the Order of the Unicorn Salient, because they say that only those who have won Game of Crowns 251 times are allowed into the order. Today, fresh unicorn, that door opened to you.

ormonos_completist.name: Ormonos Completist
ormonos_completist.statusText: You've navigated every hole in Ormonos, and earned your Ormonos Completist badge. And if you lose it, we can always get you an Ormonos Replacement Badge! No not really, I'm kidding. You just get this one.

outstanding_coddler.name: Outstanding Coddler
outstanding_coddler.statusText: You've gobbled up a lot of eggs. You've earned the title Outstanding Coddler.

overpaid_executive_fruit_tree_harvester.name: Overpaid Executive Fruit Tree Harvester
overpaid_executive_fruit_tree_harvester.statusText: You've reached to the treetops to pluck every last bit of fruit. Now it's time to enjoy the fruits of your labors with the title of Overpaid Executive Fruit Tree Harvester.

pad_pincher.name: Pad Pincher
pad_pincher.desc: Braved papercuts to harvest Paper Trees 503 times
pad_pincher.statusText: We give out a lot of random awards. This one, for harvesting your 503rd Paper Tree, is pretty much about par. And yet don't you still feel a teensy bit more special?

paper_plucker.name: Paper Plucker
paper_plucker.desc: Braved papercuts to harvest Paper Trees 73 times
paper_plucker.statusText: Congratulations. You just harvested a Paper Tree for the 73th time, earning the title Paper Plucker. Try saying that 5 times fast.

parchment_purloiner.name: Parchment Purloiner
parchment_purloiner.desc: Braved papercuts to harvest Paper Trees 1009 times
parchment_purloiner.statusText: This marks the 1009th time you've harvested a Paper Tree, thereby earning the title Parchment Purloiner. Incidentally, the Trees wanted me to assure you that it barely hurts at all.

participant.name: Participant
participant.desc: Rolled up your sleeves and contributed to all four phases of the same project
participant.statusText: You know, during phase 1 of this project, there were some who were skeptical of your stick-to-it-iveness. But you proved them wrong. Celebrate your contribution to all phases of a four-phase project with this awesome Participant badge.

participant_award__bean_division.name: Participant Award - Bean Division
participant_award__bean_division.statusText: Look at you, harvesting Bean after Bean after Bean. Here's a little Participant Award for your effort.

paul_bunions.name: Paul Bunions
paul_bunions.desc: Used a Hatchet to clear 1009 dead Trees
paul_bunions.statusText: This marks the 1009th tree you've transmogrified to a plankier state, earning your very own self the title Paul Bunions.

pennypincher.name: Pennypincher
pennypincher.statusText: Oooh. Saved up 2,022 currants, have you? That's pretty nice … don't spend it all in one place

perseverating_dipsomaniac.name: Perseverating Dipsomaniac
perseverating_dipsomaniac.desc: Maintained a solid buzz for 10 straight minutes, for no discernable reason whatsoever
perseverating_dipsomaniac.statusText: It takes endurance, focus and a certain sort of random single-mindedness to maintain a buzz for no apparent reason for 10 minutes. Clearly, you have all three of these qualities, earning you the title Perseverating Dipsomaniac.

philanthropic_member_of_the_social_const.name: Philanthropic Member of the Social Construct
philanthropic_member_of_the_social_const.desc: Contributed more than 50% to the completion of another player's restoration project
philanthropic_member_of_the_social_const.statusText: It's good to give. In this case, it's doubly good to give, as not only do you earn respect and love of a fellow glitch: you earned a badge. KABOOM!

philter_fiend.name: Philter Fiend
philter_fiend.statusText: Faster, brighter, stronger, better - Potions make the whole world zingier, right? And you should know, you've poured down 151 of them! POW!!!

piggy_hash_slinger_1st_class.name: Piggy Hash Slinger 1st Class
piggy_hash_slinger_1st_class.desc: Fed 103 little Piglets until they grew up into Piggies
piggy_hash_slinger_1st_class.statusText: Your hash slinging is so righteous that 103 Piglets have munched their way to full-grown Piggydom under your care. Each and every one of those Piggies considers you a Piggy Hash Slinger 1st Class.

piggy_nibbler.name: Piggy Nibbler
piggy_nibbler.statusText: Nice work! Those Piggies aren't going to nibble themselves, you know. You've earned a Piggy Nibbler badge.

plain_crystallizer.name: Plain Crystallizer
plain_crystallizer.statusText: You've made the world a better, shinier, sparklier place. Yes, you. With this, your 23rd Plain Crystal, you've earned the fairly self-explanatory title Plain Crystallizer.

pollokoo_completist.name: Pollokoo Completist
pollokoo_completist.statusText: You looked in every crevice, poked into every crack and managed to stumble around all of Pollokoo without getting trapped in a "Cave-in". Impressive! Here's a badge to show off, if you can find your way out, that is.

polymorphous_crystallizer.name: Polymorphous Crystallizer
polymorphous_crystallizer.statusText: We're not exactly sure what the title Polymorphous Crystallizer even means. All we know is that we give it out any time someone creates their 251st Plain Crystal. So, um, here's yours.

pop_star.name: Pop Idol
pop_star.statusText: Strong of wrist and strong of nerve, you've managed to withstand the excitement of 13 tiny explosions and risked the victorious rush (or crash of disappointment) of pulling 13 Glitchmas Crackers, and earned yourself a badge for it. POP!!! Times 13!

pork_fondler.name: Pork Fondler
pork_fondler.statusText: You know what Piggies like, and you're not afraid to give it to them. You've just been awarded a Pork Fondler badge.

pork_petter_extraordinaire.name: Pork Petter Extraordinaire
pork_petter_extraordinaire.statusText: Heavy petting should never go unrewarded. That's why, for petting 137 Piggies, you are now considered a Pork Petter Extraordinaire.

post_master.name: Post Master (General)
post_master.statusText: Before you started, there were 103 fewer posts in the world. Now there are 103 more. What for? Who knows. But that's why you're the master of posts, general division. Well done, Post Master (General)!

potion_patron.name: Potion Patron
potion_patron.statusText: They may taste foul, but who cares? Potions! You've poured down seven of 'em! ZAP!

potionographer.name: Potionographer
potionographer.statusText: What was the world like before you discovered Potions? Who knows? What's more, who cares?!? Potions are awesome. Ergo, 811 Potions are the Eight-hundred-and-eleventy-awesomenest! ZING!

practical_lepidopteral_manipulator.name: Practical Lepidopteral Manipulator
practical_lepidopteral_manipulator.statusText: You've lovingly eased the kinks out of 41 teeny little Butterfly necks, thereby earning your very own self the title Practical Lepidopteral Manipulator.

president_and_ceo_of_fruit_tree_harvesti.name: President and CEO of Fruit Tree Harvesting Inc.
president_and_ceo_of_fruit_tree_harvesti.statusText: You've plucked your way to the top of the tree. As President and CEO of Fruit Tree Harvesting Inc., you are now well within your rights to go mad with power.

pretty_fine_mulcher.name: Pretty Fine Mulcher
pretty_fine_mulcher.statusText: Way to toil on the soil! You get a Pretty Fine Mulcher badge.

pretty_fine_refiner_blue_class.name: Pretty Fine Refiner, Blue Class
pretty_fine_refiner_blue_class.statusText: That makes 2501... 2502... 2503 Blue Elements you've refined! You are hereby awarded the title Pretty Fine Refiner, Blue Class.

pretty_fine_refiner_green_class.name: Pretty Fine Refiner, Green Class
pretty_fine_refiner_green_class.statusText: Not only was that a dazzling display of masterful chunk crushery, it also marked the 2503rd Green Element you've refined. Is there a badge for that, you ask? Do you even have to ask?

pretty_fine_refiner_red_class.name: Pretty Fine Refiner, Red Class
pretty_fine_refiner_red_class.statusText: You have gone positively medieval on the buns of the common Red Element. This makes you a Pretty Fine Refiner, Red Class.

pretty_fine_refiner_shiny_class.name: Pretty Fine Refiner, Shiny Class
pretty_fine_refiner_shiny_class.statusText: See what you can do when you put your mind to it? You are indeed a Pretty Fine Refiner, Shiny Class. No joke.

pretty_fly_flycatcher.name: Pretty Fly Flycatcher
pretty_fly_flycatcher.desc: Caught 147 perfectly perfect jars of Fireflies
pretty_fly_flycatcher.statusText: Oh yeah, that's the stuff. 147 perfect jars of Fireflies. You are a Pretty Fly Flycatcher. And yet, don't you think you could still be flyer?

pretty_good_griddler.name: Pretty Good Griddler
pretty_good_griddler.desc: Fried up 23 meals with a Frying Pan.
pretty_good_griddler.statusText: Mmm... it smells like Gamma's house in here! You deserve this Pretty Good Griddler badge.

pretty_good_samaritan.name: Pretty Good Samaritan
pretty_good_samaritan.statusText: Just give 'er! Your good samaritizing has just earned you a Pretty Good Samaritan badge.

professional_bean_tree_fondler.name: Professional Bean Tree Fondler
professional_bean_tree_fondler.statusText: Know what's even better than a Not-Quite-Pro Bean Tree Fondler? A Professional Bean Tree Fondler, Which is you. Embrace the glory.

professional_furniturerer.name: Professional Furniturerer
professional_furniturerer.statusText: Like a true grafter, you put heart and soul (also wood, snails etc)  into 101 pieces of furniture. Sit back and appreciate the Professional standard of your Furniturerering. And your badge. Here's your badge.

project_enthusiast.name: Project Enthusiast
project_enthusiast.desc: Helped out with 53 phases of a project
project_enthusiast.statusText: For some people, hard work is its own reward. For the rest of us, there are badges. We're officially designating you a Project Enthusiast. Go, you!

promising_lush.name: Promising Lush
promising_lush.statusText: You're not a full-blown dipsomaniac yet, but you've taken the first crucial steps toward it, and earned yourself a Promising Lush badge. I'll drink to that. Or, more likely, you will.

protein_time.name: Protein Time!!!
protein_time.statusText: Glurk. That was your eleventh raw meat. You've earned a Protein Time badge.

pullet_provenderizer.name: Pullet Provenderizer
pullet_provenderizer.statusText: You've nourished 23 hungry, hungry Chicks to squawky, squawky Chickenhood. For this, you're earned the honorary title Pullet Provenderizer.

pulse_frappe_mix_blend.name: Pulse, Frappe, Mix & Blend
pulse_frappe_mix_blend.desc: Blended 11 drinks or sno cones with a Blender.
pulse_frappe_mix_blend.statusText: You are starting to learn your way around a blender, that's for sure. As a token of your limited accomplishment so far, the Pulse, Frappe, Mix & Blend badge.

pumpkin_carver.name: Pumpkin Carver
pumpkin_carver.desc: Carved the full collection of Pumpkins
pumpkin_carver.statusText: You sharpened your sharp things, and brought life to large vegetables. Or at least faces. Weird gurning faces that smell of burning vegetables when you fill them with Fireflies. Yay you!

qualified_artifactologist.name: Qualified Artifactologist
qualified_artifactologist.statusText: You're a veritable historian, a walking museum. Ten artifacts reassembled, the secrets of the ancients are yours to unfurl, with your new shiny title and your even shinier badge.

qualified_botanical_health_professional.name: Qualified Botanical Health Professional
qualified_botanical_health_professional.statusText: Anyone can be a lousy tree hugger. Only a chosen few can be called a Qualified Botanical Health Professional, and for that to happen you'd have had to have administered antidote to 79 trees, which you did! Bonsai!

quick_on_your_feat.name: Quick on Your Feat
quick_on_your_feat.desc: Contributed to a feat in the first 30 minutes
quick_on_your_feat.statusText: You knew what you wanted - you wanted to feat: and feat you did: first off the blocks, quick off the mark, fast as lightning, in 30 minutes or less. ZOOM!

quiet_tragedy.name: Quiet Tragedy
quiet_tragedy.statusText: You died, perished, you located a bucket and kicked it. You ceased to be. You carked it, you shuffled off your mortal coil. And you did it all in the comfort of your own home. A Quiet Tragedy, but it's all ok now, right? Chin up: Have a badge.

rainbow_brite.name: Rainbo Brite
rainbow_brite.desc: Whipped up 73 Rainbo Sno Cones in an unexcitingly generic red blender
rainbow_brite.statusText: You're the cutest, sparkliest, sprinkliest, twinkiest, wispiest rainboest sno cone blender-upper that ever there was! SQUEEE!

rainbow_connection.name: The Rainbo Connection
rainbow_connection.desc: Magically blended 317 Rainbo Sno Cones (in a distinctly non-magical blender)
rainbow_connection.statusText: Rainbo Sno Cones: Are they visions? Illusions? Something with nothing to hide? Or are they just the delicious frozen blended treat that just snagged you a badge? All of the above. And more. That's why there's so many songs about them.

rainbow_taster.name: Rainbo Taster
rainbow_taster.statusText: You carefully constructed enough Rainbo Sno Cones to become a certified, qualified Taster of Rainbo. Word.

rainmaking_noob.name: Rainmaking Noob
rainmaking_noob.desc: Dispensed a good watering to 11 Bean Trees
rainmaking_noob.statusText: With this, your eleventh Bean Tree watering, you've taken your journey down a damp but rewarding path. You deserve the honorable title Rainmaking Noob.

raking_in_the_img.name: Raking in the iMG
raking_in_the_img.desc: Drew more than 1009 iMG per day in Stipend
raking_in_the_img.statusText: You built it. They came. And while you were sleeping, enough petting, harvesting, tending and whatever else was done in your home street to raise 1009 iMG and a shiny new badge. YAY!

rambler_first_class.name: Rambler, First Class
rambler_first_class.statusText: You've roamed and rambled and followed your footsteps, and now you've earned the title Rambler, First Class!

rambler_second_class.name: Rambler, Second Class
rambler_second_class.statusText: Wow! You've covered a lot of ground since your travels began. You've earned this Rambler, Second Class badge.

rambler_third_class.name: Rambler, Third Class
rambler_third_class.statusText: You sure have itchy feet! We don't have any soothing ointment, but we do have this Rambler, Third Class badge. Cherish it!

ranger_of_the_nights_watch.name: Ranger of the Night's Watch
ranger_of_the_nights_watch.statusText: In the battle for the crown, you've shown an ever-vigilant commitment to keeping your eye on the goal and your mitts on the metal. Thus have you attained the first level of crown-protectorate: Arise, Ranger of the Night's Watch.

rasana_completist.name: Rasana Completist
rasana_completist.statusText: The Rasana Gorge has revealed its secrets to you, from the thrill of its edge to the surprising mini climate at its bottom. You're not only a Rasana completist, you're the foremost Rasana expert. But you only get a badge for the completist bit. Hurrah!

re_peater.name: Re-Peater
re_peater.desc: Harvested 41 slightly funky Blocks of Peat
re_peater.statusText: For rescuing 41 Blocks of Peat from a dreary, if peaceful, bog existence, you've just earned the title Re-Peater.

really_unconfounded_compounder.name: Really Un-Confounded Compounder
really_unconfounded_compounder.desc: Cooked up 503 compounds with a Test Tube
really_unconfounded_compounder.statusText: Hey now! Cooking up 503 compounds is no small task. You've earned every bit of this here Really Un-Confounded Compounder Badge.

regular_whack_job.name: Regular Whack Job
regular_whack_job.desc: Used a Hatchet to clear 53 dead Trees
regular_whack_job.statusText: You've shivered those timbers well and good. Once the wood chips have settled, take a moment to admire your brand plankin' new Regular Whack Job badge.

respected_tree_doctor.name: Respected Tree Doctor
respected_tree_doctor.statusText: There's nothing sadder than a poisonified tree. Likewise, there's nothing happier than an unpoisionified tree. Now, stick 127 of those trees together that have received antidote, and you have the kind of party you would expect to honor a Respected Tree Doctor. Just like you.

restorer_of_stuff.name: Restorer of Stuff
restorer_of_stuff.desc: Brought 17 cultivation projects back from the brink
restorer_of_stuff.statusText: Felicitations on those 17 cultivation projects you restored to full health. Not only did they continue to give you stuff, they also earned you this badge!

right_honorable_robber_ducker.name: Right Honorable Robber-Ducker
right_honorable_robber_ducker.statusText: You've smoothly eluded the grabby little hands of 509 Juju Bandits, and there's only one thing can be said to that: Robber ducker, you're the one.

rolling_boiler.name: Rolling Boiler
rolling_boiler.statusText: You're getting pretty handy with a Saucepan! You've earned a Rolling Boiler badge.

roobrik_completist.name: Roobrik Completist
roobrik_completist.statusText: I like long walks by the beach, beautiful sunsets and really tall trees. Since you've been to every single spot in Roobrik, I'd say you do too! Or maybe you just like hopping around. Whatever floats your boat champ, I don't judge. I just hand out badges to glitches like you.

rook_ranger.name: Rook Ranger
rook_ranger.desc: Fended off Rook with the aid of a tincture
rook_ranger.statusText: The power of Rook Armour has saved your bacon - or at least kept it pink and floppy rather than crispy and cremated - this time. Consider yourself a decorated Rook Ranger. Hoo-ha!

rookie_bubble_tree_cuddler.name: Rookie Bubble Tree Cuddler
rookie_bubble_tree_cuddler.statusText: The Bubble Trees appreciate your clumsy but well-intentioned petting. You've earned the status of Rookie Bubble Tree Cuddler.

roux_guru.name: Roux Guru
roux_guru.statusText: No lumps here! You're a certified Roux Guru.

rumrunner.name: Rumrunner
rumrunner.desc: Dramatically distilled 61 Hooches in your back yard
rumrunner.statusText: Under a veil of secrecy and a blanket of moral fog, you stealthily distilled 61 Hooches. What happened to them then, you say, is none of your concern. Unless you drank them yourself. In which case, Cheers!

sac_bagger.name: Sac Bagger
sac_bagger.statusText: Well done! You've just scooped your 283rd Jellisac. I have no idea what you're doing with them all. That's between you and your giants. But here. An official Sac Bagger badge. For you.

saint_peater.name: Saint Peater
saint_peater.desc: Harvested 5003 slightly funky Blocks of Peat
saint_peater.statusText: With 5003 successfully harvested Blocks of Peat under your belt, it's probably time to get a bigger belt. Purely up to you, of course. Just think about it while you ponder the awesomeness of your new title: Saint Peater.

salatu_completist.name: Salatu Completist
salatu_completist.statusText: On hearing the words "Yariam Jam", some people might reach for the bread and peanut butter. But not you, Peanut, because you're well travelled enough to know every corner of Salatu. That's what makes you a Salatu Completist. Go you!

samudra_completist.name: Samudra Completist
samudra_completist.statusText: Blub blub blub, it's bright in this tub. Hey, what get's darker AND brighter at the same time? That's right! Samudra does! I'm not even sure how you got around this whole place but it seems like I should give you something worthwhile for doing it. But since I don't have anything like that, I'll give you this badge instead.

saute_savant.name: Saute Savant
saute_savant.desc: Fried up 79 meals with a Frying Pan.
saute_savant.statusText: Well, grease my griddle! You've just earned a gently fricasseed Saute Savant badge.

seamster.name: Seamster
seamster.desc: Lovingly crafted 17 pieces of general fabric
seamster.statusText: You've created 17 tiny miracles in general fabric, soft yet pliable, strong yet fluid, it's like the fabric of time, except it's the fabric of fabric. Have a badge!

seasoned_scullery_sleuth.name: Seasoned Scullery Sleuth
seasoned_scullery_sleuth.statusText: Eureka! The kitchen holds few secrets from you. You've earned the title Seasoned Scullery Sleuth.

second_series_liberator.name: Second Series Liberator
second_series_liberator.desc: Set free one of each of the releasable Series 2 Cubimals
second_series_liberator.statusText: 12 little series 2 cubimal friends are out there somewhere relishing their freedom thanks to you. Bravo, Liberator. And for your magnanimosity, a badge.

secondbest_bubble_farmer.name: Second-Best Bubble Farmer
secondbest_bubble_farmer.statusText: You've achieved the penultimate level of Bubble Farmerdom. Warning: Second-Best Bubble Farmers sometimes can't get over knowing that they're second best. Ask yourself, how are you going to handle your newfound status?

secondrate_rainmaker.name: Second-Rate Rainmaker
secondrate_rainmaker.statusText: What would the plants do without you? You deserve the title Second-Rate Rainmaker.

self_sufficientiser.name: Self-sufficientiser
self_sufficientiser.desc: Had 7 cultivated resources on your home street
self_sufficientiser.statusText: Proudly self sufficient (at least in the things you've planted), you created 7 marvellous resources on your home street. Come the revolution, you'll have a good stockpile. And here's the badge to prove it.

semi_pro_decrustifier.name: Semi-Pro Decrustifier
semi_pro_decrustifier.statusText: For dislodging 283 troublesome Barnacles for the purpose of putting them to good use for once in their sorry lives, you've earned the title Semi-Pro Decrustifier.

senior_admixificator.name: Senior Admixificator
senior_admixificator.desc: Used a Beaker to stir 41 powders
senior_admixificator.statusText: You've reached the highest pinnacle of admixing glory. Now show the world with your new title of Senior Admixificator.

senior_dough_puncher.name: Senior Dough Puncher
senior_dough_puncher.statusText: You've got a nose for nosing out recipes. You're hereby promoted to Senior Dough Puncher status.

senior_mending_manager_kitchen_division.name: Senior Mending Manager, Kitchen Division
senior_mending_manager_kitchen_division.desc: Used a Tinkertool to repair 127 cooking tools from their half-life to a fully-repaired state
senior_mending_manager_kitchen_division.statusText: The world would be a hungrier, grouchier, angrier place without your Tinkering skills. Stare at this Senior Mending Manager badge every day and say to yourself: I am a shining star, a bright shining star.

senior_ok_explorer.name: Senior OK Explorer
senior_ok_explorer.statusText: Rollin', rollin', rollin', keep them doggies rollin' with this Senior OK Explorer badge.

senor_sprinkles.name: Senor Sprinkles
senor_sprinkles.desc: Doled out waterings to 41 thirsty Bubble Trees
senor_sprinkles.statusText: You've be-wetted 41 thirsty Bubble Trees, earning yourself the coveted title Senor Sprinkles. Remember: Keep those Bubble Trees wet, and they'll keep you up to your knobs in Bubbles.

sergeant_coppersmith.name: Sergeant Coppersmith
sergeant_coppersmith.desc: Vigorously rubbed, tugged and massaged 137 Plain Metal Ingots into Copper
sergeant_coppersmith.statusText: When you rub and tug this many Plain Metal Ingots into Copper, they call you Coppersmith: Sergeant Coppersmith. (They call you other stuff, too.)

serious_scrabbler.name: Serious Scrabbler
serious_scrabbler.statusText: Paydirt! Well, not quite. It's just a Serious Scrabbler badge to reward your mining efforts. But still, better sock it away before a claimjumper gets wind of it.

severus_sash.name: Severus Sash
severus_sash.statusText: Time was, someone with the dedication to make 457 Potions would have been awarded an actual Serverus Sash, named for some Master of Potions or other. But so what? You got this awesome badge!

sheet_snatcher.name: Sheet Snatcher
sheet_snatcher.desc: Braved papercuts to harvest Paper Trees 283 times
sheet_snatcher.statusText: Well done. For harvesting Paper Trees 283 times, you've just gone and earned yourself the title Sheet Snatcher. Um, you were planning to recycle those, hey?

shimla_mirch_completist.name: Shimla Mirch Completist
shimla_mirch_completist.desc: Visited every location in Shimla Mirch
shimla_mirch_completist.statusText: You've peeked into every last dark mungy corner of Shimla Mirch, and that deserves some credit. And that credit takes the form of the title Shimla Mirch Completist.

shiny_nugget_award.name: Shiny Nugget Award
shiny_nugget_award.statusText: You've hit the motherlode! Well, the achievement motherlode, anyway. For your assiduous pick-wielding, you've won the Shiny Nugget Award.

shovel_jockey.name: Shovel Jockey
shovel_jockey.desc: Used a Shovel 29 times to dig Patches or Dirt Piles
shovel_jockey.statusText: You are one dogged digger. In honour of your skuldiggery, here's a Shovel Jockey badge.

showered_with_sloth_dribble.name: Showered with Sloth-Dribble
showered_with_sloth_dribble.desc: Spat at by a sloth 11 times
showered_with_sloth_dribble.statusText: So much do the Sloths love you now that they spit snails at you without even needing a rod. Yes, you get showered by a fine mist of Sloth-dribble, but is it worth it? Yes! Because you also get a badge!

shriner_fortyniner.name: Shriner Forty-Niner
shriner_fortyniner.desc: Dug deep and donated to Shrines 1049 times
shriner_fortyniner.statusText: You've just earned the designation Shriner Forty-Niner! Though, technically, you've donated to 1049 Shrines. Let's not get into the technicalities.

shrub_snuggler.name: Shrub Snuggler
shrub_snuggler.desc: Administered a sound petting to 127 Gas Plants
shrub_snuggler.statusText: What is the sound of one hand petting? We don't know, either, but that doesn't stop us from awarding you the noble title of Shrub Snuggler.

significant_insignia_collector.name: Significant Insignia Collector
significant_insignia_collector.desc: Painstakingly earned 17 Emblems of the Giants
significant_insignia_collector.statusText: Righteous. Your Emblem collection is a thing of beauty. Not huge, nor terribly awesome, but notable. Reflect on where you go from here as you stroke your Significant Insignia Collector badge.

silver_cleaver_award.name: Silver Cleaver Award
silver_cleaver_award.desc: Minced, chopped and hacked 79 recipes with a Knife & Board.
silver_cleaver_award.statusText: You've really honed your chopping abilities. You win the Silver Cleaver Award!

silver_gristle_award.name: Silver Gristle Award
silver_gristle_award.statusText: Hot dog! You've really pigged out. You win a carnelicious Silver Gristle Award.

sizzler_supreme.name: Sizzler Supreme
sizzler_supreme.desc: Fried up 137 meals with a Frying Pan.
sizzler_supreme.statusText: You can frizzle fo' shizzle. You've earned the title Sizzler Supreme!

slime_harvester.name: Slime Harvester
slime_harvester.statusText: It takes a certain amount of chutzpah to scoop up a Jellisac with one's bare hands. To do this 41 times takes exactly 41 times that amount. You're a bonafide Slime Harvester, you are.

slippery_customer.name: Slippery Customer
slippery_customer.statusText: Like a seasoned outlaw (or since you weren't the one breaking the law, a seasoned in-law) you've eluded 29 Juju Bandits. You're one Slippery Customer, and that's for sure.

sloth_stuffer.name: Sloth Stuffer
sloth_stuffer.desc: Fed a single sloth until it was full
sloth_stuffer.statusText: Just when you thought those sloths could keep ramming rods into their gaping maws forever, you managed to fill one up entirely. Mazel tov! You stuffed a sloth!

slughorn_medallion.name: Slughorn Medallion
slughorn_medallion.statusText: The Metaphorical Medallion of Master Slughorn - someone who was purported to know a lot about potions back in the day - is awarded to anyone who has made 47 Potions. Someone like… well… you! YAY!

sneezeorama.name: Sneeze-O-Rama
sneezeorama.desc: Made five other players sneeze simultaneously with Sneezing Powder
sneezeorama.statusText: Atchoo! Hey, watch it with that stuff. You've just earned a Sneeze-O-Rama badge for making five players sneeze at once with your Sneezing Powder.

sociable_susan.name: Sociable Susan
sociable_susan.statusText: On a visiting spree? Swinging by to see pals? Whatever you're doing, you've visited 23 home streets, and earned yourself a badge for it. Ker-CHING!

social_butterfly.name: Social Butterfly
social_butterfly.desc: Cheerfully said Hi to 53 different players in one game day
social_butterfly.statusText: You could've walked on by, but no: you took the time to say "Hi" 53 times, to 53 Glitches. Your sense of social satisfaction is enough, but have a badge anyway, you Social Butterfly, you. Or is that "Social Butterflhi"? No it isn't. That's just silly.

social_hi_skipper.name: Social Antisocialist
social_hi_skipper.desc: Set 7 Daily Records for Hi Sign evasion. Daily Records are recognized at the end of each game day
social_hi_skipper.statusText: It doesn't take much to just stop and say hello: it takes a lot more effort to run from a hello. Run, run and run until you've got 7 daily records for Hi Sign evasion. Sure, being social is important. You know what else is important? Badges!

somewhat_fly_flycatcher.name: Somewhat Fly Flycatcher
somewhat_fly_flycatcher.desc: Caught 73 perfectly perfect jars of Fireflies
somewhat_fly_flycatcher.statusText: Nice! 73 perfect jars of Fireflies is pretty impressive. And yet it still only earns you the title Somewhat Fly Flycatcher. What can I say? Flycatching is a competitive biz.

soso_sower.name: So-So Sower
soso_sower.statusText: You know that you can't reap without sowing. You've earned a So-So Sower badge!

soso_supplicator.name: So-So Supplicator
soso_supplicator.statusText: When it comes to donating to Shrines, you're a-give'rin' but you're not quite a-quiverin'. At this point, the best title we can award you is So-So Supplicant.

sparkle_buddy.name: Sparkle Buddy
sparkle_buddy.desc: Made seven players extra-happy at the same time with Sparkle Powder
sparkle_buddy.statusText: Waytago! A regular life of the party you are, making all those nice people happy with your Sparkle Powder. You deserve the coveted Sparkle Buddy badge.

special_agent_tinkering_ops.name: Special Agent, Tinkering Ops
special_agent_tinkering_ops.desc: Wielded a Tinkertool to repair 10009 units worth of tools
special_agent_tinkering_ops.statusText: You've tinkered your way to the status of Special Agent, Tinkering Ops. We're still working on the secret handshake. We'll keep you posted on that.

spice_examiner.name: Spice Examiner
spice_examiner.desc: Carefully scrutinized every spice in existence
spice_examiner.statusText: You've sniffed, snorted, scrutinized, studied, flattered, rubbed and loved your way through every spice. If anyone deserves the Spice Examiner badge, it's you.

spice_intern.name: Spice Intern
spice_intern.statusText: Some day you may look back on the achievement of converting 53 spices and say 'I was so naive back then.' But for now, bask in the glory of your Spice Intern badge.

spin_doctor.name: Spin Doctor
spin_doctor.desc: Spun 2051 fiber into 293 thread in one super long spin
spin_doctor.statusText: What time is it? It's time to mark your graduation from run-of-the-mill spinner to Spin Doctor. Gratz!

sprout_stroker.name: Sprout Stroker
sprout_stroker.desc: Administered a sound petting to 11 Gas Plants
sprout_stroker.statusText: For a newcomer to the field of Gas Plant petting, you've done an impressive job. You are hereby awarded the designation Sprout Stroker!

stalker_noncreepy_designation.name: Stalker, Non-Creepy Designation
stalker_noncreepy_designation.desc: Officially followed another player through 3 different streets
stalker_noncreepy_designation.statusText: Following other people is the sort of behaviour that has been known to get people socked, or at the very least glared at. But in this case you get the special title of Stalker, Non-Creepy Designation.

starter_for_tinsmithery.name: Starter for Tinsmithery
starter_for_tinsmithery.desc: Lovingly rubbed 41 basic Plain Metal Ingots into superior Tin
starter_for_tinsmithery.statusText: You done rubbed that Tin real good, creating for yourself a promising Starter for Tinsmithery, and earning yourself the title of Starter Tinsmith. Whether you want that title or not is your business, not mine.

string_practicioner.name: String Practitioner
string_practicioner.desc: Skillfully spun fiber directly into string (requires Spellbound Spindle upgrade)
string_practicioner.statusText: You'd heard crazy theories about string arising from the loom of those almost supernaturally skilled in the fiber arts. But string theory is one thing. String practice is another. You nailed it, String Practicioner!

student_of_artifactology.name: Student of Artifactology
student_of_artifactology.statusText: The memories of the ancients buzz through you as you handle artifacts. Having carefully reassembled three, hopefully it hasn't given you a headache. It has, however, given you a badge. YAY!

subwayfarer.name: Subwayfarer
subwayfarer.statusText: Why walk when you can ride? And why ride anything else, when you can ride the subway? Good questions, these. As a bonafide Subwayfarer, you can ponder them before your next stop.

supafly_flycatcher.name: Supafly Flycatcher
supafly_flycatcher.desc: Caught 501 perfectly perfect jars of Fireflies
