supafly_flycatcher.statusText: Yes! 501 perfect jars of Fireflies, making you a certifiably Supafly Flycatcher. Tell all your friends.

super_awesome_intern_hburger.name: Super Awesome Intern
super_awesome_intern_hburger.desc: A super-special, ultra-unique, "thank you for being a snowflake" award for your outstanding contribution to Glitchology.
super_awesome_intern_hburger.statusText: There's no one quite like HBurger. Quite literally, now, because you've just been awarded the Super Awesome Intern badge! And this super awesome burger! No, wait, no burger. Just the badge. Marvellous though, right?

super_duper_soaker.name: Super Duper Soaker
super_duper_soaker.statusText: You've helped dozens of Fruit Trees through many a dry patch. You are indeed a Super Duper Soaker.

super_featy.name: Super-Featy
super_featy.statusText: Tireless? Maybe. Determined? Certainly. Displaying traits of Super-Glitchian feat-conquering powers? Yes, yes, 137 times yes. Mazel Tov!

super_saucier.name: Super Saucier
super_saucier.statusText: You've just earned a deglazed Super Saucier badge. Keep on stirring!

super_soaker.name: Super Soaker
super_soaker.statusText: Anybody can walk past a Fruit Tree and pour some water on it. But only special people like you take a bit more time to care for the trees others ignore. Congratulations. You're a Super Soaker.

super_supreme_egg_plant_coddler.name: Super Supreme Egg Plant Coddler
super_supreme_egg_plant_coddler.desc: Administered firm, life-sustaining pettings to 127 Egg Plants
super_supreme_egg_plant_coddler.statusText: The votes are in. You have been nominated Super Supreme Egg Plant Coddler. The title comes with a badge and various secret Egg-related duties.

super_tricksy_treater.name: Super Tricksy-Treater
super_tricksy_treater.desc: Gave Candy to 257 Lucky Candy-Lovers during Zilloween
super_tricksy_treater.statusText: 257 candies given to happy candy-eaters? You clearly don't believe in hoarding the sweet stuff. And why would you, honeybuns? You're sweet enough already! (Yeech. Sorry)

superior_irrigationist.name: Superior Irrigationist
superior_irrigationist.statusText: That's some good sprinkling! You deserve a somewhat moist Superior Irrigationist badge.

superior_mixologist.name: Superior Mixologist
superior_mixologist.desc: Crafted 41 cocktails with a Cocktail Shaker.
superior_mixologist.statusText: The ratios, the timing, the pure finesse: not everyone appreciates the finer points of crafting a fine cocktail. But you, having crafted a whole 41 of them surely do. Congrats, Superior Mixologist.

supreme_egg_plant_coddler.name: Supreme Egg Plant Coddler
supreme_egg_plant_coddler.desc: Administered life-sustaining pettings to 41 Egg Plants
supreme_egg_plant_coddler.statusText: You have a nice technique for petting. Firm, yet gentle as a Butterfly handshake. You deserve the title Supreme Egg Plant Coddler.

sura_completist.name: Sura Completist
sura_completist.statusText: *Brush* *Brush* Oh! Sorry, I thought you were a fox. If you're not a fox, then why were you hiding in those bushes? Maybe you were looking for this Sura completist badge, hmmn?

swine_snuggler.name: Swine Snuggler
swine_snuggler.statusText: Petting piggies never gets boar-ing for you. You are hereby an honorary Swine Snuggler.

tahli_completist.name: Tahli Completist
tahli_completist.statusText: Aww, so Cute! The sloths I mean. Not that I'm saying you're ugly or anything, it's just that, well uh … here, have this convenient Tahli completist badge I just found.

tamila_completist.name: Tamila Completist
tamila_completist.statusText: You've tripped lightly though Tamila, from the fringes of the plains to the depths of the enchanted forest. In what way was the forest enchanted, you ask? Enchanted enough to reward you this badge, little Tamila Completist. THAT'S how enchanted.

team_player.name: Team Player
team_player.desc: Helped out with 17 phases of a project
team_player.statusText: There's no I in team. Though we did hear there was once a lobby for a silent P at the beginning. You know, like ptarmigan or pterodactyl. However you spell it, it's the first word in Team Player, and that's what you are.

tentative_petter.name: Tentative Petter
tentative_petter.statusText: Pettifying the first 11 Spice Plants is the trickiest. And when you think about it, it wasn't even all that tricky. Be that as it may, you've earned a Tentative Petter badge.

the_candyglitch.name: The Candyglitch
the_candyglitch.desc: Gave Candy to 499 Lucky Candy-Lickers during Zilloween
the_candyglitch.statusText: Who can take a sunrise, sprinkle it with dew, cover it in chocolate and a miracle or two? The Candyglitch can! That's you! YAY!

the_cigar.name: The Cigar
the_cigar.desc: Came very close to top contributor status
the_cigar.statusText: You came close to the category of Top Feat Contributor: so close. So very very close. Some would say 'close, but no cigar'. But they would be wrong, because you came close AND got The Cigar. Gratz.

the_dampinator.name: The Dampinator
the_dampinator.desc: Dispensed a good watering to 127 Bean Trees
the_dampinator.statusText: You've done a lot of watering. To a lot of Bean Trees. And that's why they now call you... The Dampinator!

the_hugginator.name: The Hugginator
the_hugginator.desc: Squoze 503 Chickens in a too-friendly sorta way
the_hugginator.statusText: Has it occurred to you that maybe you're taking this Chicken-squeezing thing too far? Think of this Hugginator badge as a friendly reminder to keep things in perspective.

the_hydrophile.name: The Hydrophile
the_hydrophile.desc: Administered a much-needed watering to 127 hot Spice Plants
the_hydrophile.statusText: You've administered much-needed waterings to 127 hot Spice Plants. You are not just any hydrophile, you are The Hydrophile.

the_imp.name: The Imp
the_imp.statusText: Others may not have realised your cheeky rise to power, but slowly, surely, you've learnt to keep your little mitts on the crown to the point you've reached the first level of clammy-handed crown-clutching. 101 seconds?! You little Imp, you!

the_kindness_of_strangers.name: The Kindness of Strangers
the_kindness_of_strangers.desc: Received more than 2503 iMG per day in a Daily Stipend
the_kindness_of_strangers.statusText: Enough mining, whistling, harvesting, scooping was done on your home street to net you 2503 iMG *and* this badge. There you go! You really CAN depend on the kindness of strangers.

the_saturator.name: The Saturator
the_saturator.desc: Doled out waterings to 127 thirsty Bubble Trees
the_saturator.statusText: Bubble Trees like a drink now and again. If they had anything resembling a neo-cortex, they be happy to know that The Saturator is on the job. (That's your new title, BTW.)

the_swarm.name: The Swarm
the_swarm.desc: Raced a cubimal as part of a 31-cubimal mega-race extravaganza
the_swarm.statusText: You must feel honoured to be a part of one of the most mystical events in the world of the cubimals: the swarm. Your cubimal is shivering with joy having been one of the 31-strong swarm, and that's down to you. Huzzah!

thrash_metallurgist.name: Thrash Metallurgist
thrash_metallurgist.desc: Professionally rubbed 137 Plain Metal Ingots into Molybdenum
thrash_metallurgist.statusText: Now you've thrashed your way up the Metallurgy pile, and created your 137th Molybdenum Ingot, you'll finally be recognised as a true Thrash Metallurgist. But there's always room for improvement.

threader_of_renown.name: Threader of Renown
threader_of_renown.statusText: Five glorious strings of tiny round reimagined beads have you slowly, painstakingly, reassembled into necklaces. Glory be, Threader, you deserve your renown. And: your badge!

timber_jack.name: Timber Jack
timber_jack.desc: Used a Hatchet to gently harvest Planks from Wood Trees 79 times
timber_jack.statusText: Little Glitch took an axe and gave a tree 40 whacks. 79 trees that Glitch did smack, so let's call him (or her!) a Timber Jack.

timber_nut.name: Timber Nut
timber_nut.desc: Petted and watered 103 Wood Trees to the full woody bloom of adulthood
timber_nut.statusText: With 103 Wood trees watered and petted to maturity, you are what we call a Timber Nut around these parts. That's mostly a good thing. Mostly.

tinker_trainee_kitchen_division.name: Tinker Trainee, Kitchen Division
tinker_trainee_kitchen_division.desc: Used a Tinkertool to repair 3 cooking tools from their half-life to a fully-repaired state
tinker_trainee_kitchen_division.statusText: Where would the world be without cooking tool fixers like yourself? Probably without access to much-needed snacks, that's where. Bravo. You've earned the title Tinker Trainee, Kitchen Division.

tool_artiste.name: Tool Artiste
tool_artiste.desc: Painstakingly crafted 283 tools with a Tinkertool
tool_artiste.statusText: When you've made 283 tools, you've moved beyond mere tool making and into the realm of tool artistry. Here's your Tool Artiste badge. Your beret is in the mail.

toolie_apprentice.name: Toolie Apprentice
toolie_apprentice.desc: Painstakingly crafted 17 tools with a Tinkertool
toolie_apprentice.statusText: You, friend, are a dab hand with the Tinkertool, as evidenced by the many fine and powerful tools you have created. Please accept the designation Toolie Apprentice.

toolsmith.name: Toolsmith
toolsmith.desc: Painstakingly crafted 127 tools with a Tinkertool
toolsmith.statusText: Nice. Tools. And I'm not just saying that. Here's the Toolsmith badge to prove it.

toolwright.name: Toolwright
toolwright.desc: Painstakingly crafted 41 tools with a Tinkertool
toolwright.statusText: With 41 successfully crafted tools under your belt, you're ready to move up the ranks to Toolwright. Oh yeah. Nothing's gonna stop you now.

top_tinsmith.name: Top Tinsmith
top_tinsmith.desc: Lovingly rubbed 501 basic Plain Metal Ingots into superior Tin
top_tinsmith.statusText: For outstanding achievement of racing to the top of the Tin-smithery charts, you are hereby awarded the title of Top Tinsmith, with all the honours that entails. P.S. There are no honours.

total_tool.name: Total Tool
total_tool.desc: Painstakingly crafted 503 tools with a Tinkertool
total_tool.statusText: Tools are very useful things. You've made 503 of them, making you a very useful thing-maker. Or, as we prefer to say, a Total Tool.

tower_secret_areas.name: 11 Secrets of the Jethimadh Tower Base
tower_secret_areas.desc: Found all 11 spots in the Jethimadh Tower Base.
tower_secret_areas.statusText: You sneaky little bugger! You found every last one of the 11 secret spots in the Jethimadh Tower Base? Good job! But, please keep the secrets safe …

trader_carl.name: Trader Carl
trader_carl.statusText: You've traded your way to the status of Trader Carl. Named for a guy named Carl who traded a fair bit back in the day, this badge is much coveted amongst those who trade. May Carl bless your every transaction.

trader_joe.name: Trader Joe
trader_joe.statusText: It's not easy to earn a Trader Joe badge. It's not hard, either, but you've done it, so good on you.

trader_vic.name: Trader Vic
trader_vic.statusText: To have traded as much as you indicates high levels of interpersonal synergizing. In recognition of your delightfully traderous heart, you are now a Trader Vic.

trainee_tree_medic.name: Trainee Tree Medic
trainee_tree_medic.statusText: You have saved the lives of 23 trees with your antidote administering skills. Prepare to learn how trees show gratitude to a Trainee Tree Medic. (That would be you).

transrational_meat_aficionado.name: Trans-Rational Meat Aficionado
transrational_meat_aficionado.desc: Nibbled on an impressive - and impressed - 503 Piggies
transrational_meat_aficionado.statusText: It's not outrageous to wonder if all you do with your time is nibble Piggies, having nibbled 503 of the critters. Hence your new title: Trans-Rational Meat Aficionado.

trigger_happy_trap_duster.name: Trigger-Happy Trap-Duster
trigger_happy_trap_duster.statusText: An almost unbelievable 503 Dust Traps have been triggered by your light-footed exploreating. Jaws have been dropped, eyebrows raised, and you have been crowned Trigger-Happy Trap-Duster. And you thought no one noticed.

twinkle_toed_trap_triggerer.name: Twinkle-Toed Trap Triggerer
twinkle_toed_trap_triggerer.statusText: By luck or by painstaking planning, you've triggered the mighty flop of 37 Dust Traps and earned yourself this glorious badgling. Mazeltov!

uberculturalist.name: Überculturalist
uberculturalist.statusText: There's a rich, salty, and somewhat savoury smell. Is that you? Yes. And the sweat of the herbatious labors that have resulted in the world being 5003 herbs richer, and you being awarded this badge. Gratz!

unconfounded_compounder.name: Un-Confounded Compounder
unconfounded_compounder.desc: Concocted 41 compounds with a Test Tube
unconfounded_compounder.statusText: Congratulations on concocting 41 compounds! Wear your new Un-Confounded Compounder Badge with honour.

unlicenced_teleporter_f_class.name: Unlicensed Teleporter (F Class)
unlicenced_teleporter_f_class.desc: Teleported 501 times, with almost perfect reassembly every time
unlicenced_teleporter_f_class.statusText: Teleportation! It's the wave of the future! But first let's celebrate the wave of the past. For your 501 practically flawless teleports, you've just earned the title Unlicensed Teleporter, F Class.

unlicensed_teleporter_g_class.name: Unlicensed Teleporter (G Class)
unlicensed_teleporter_g_class.desc: Teleported 199 times, with almost perfect reassembly every time
unlicensed_teleporter_g_class.statusText: For teleporting yourself 199 times and re-assembling yourself almost perfectly every time, you've earned the title Unlicensed Teleporter, G Class.

unlicensed_teleporter_n_class.name: Unlicensed Teleporter (N Class)
unlicensed_teleporter_n_class.desc: Teleported 2501 times, with almost perfect reassembly every time
unlicensed_teleporter_n_class.statusText: Congratulations! Your new title, Unlicensed Teleporter, N Class, is eight letters further in the alphabet than your F Class designation. What difference this makes is a source of wild speculation.

unlicensed_teleporter_z_class.name: Unlicensed Teleporter (Z Class)
unlicensed_teleporter_z_class.desc: Teleported 10,009 times, with almost perfect reassembly every time
unlicensed_teleporter_z_class.statusText: Not sure which is more impressive: the fact that you've done all that teleporting, or the fact that you did it without researching its long-term effects. Either way, congratulations! You've moved up the ranks to Unlicensed Teleporter, Z Class.

up_n_comer.name: Up 'n' Comer
up_n_comer.desc: Helped out with 137 phases of a project
up_n_comer.statusText: Some folks are content to go up. Others are happy to settle for just coming. A rare few do both, thereby earning themselves the title Up 'n' Comer.

uralia_completist.name: Uralia Completist
uralia_completist.statusText: They say size isn't everything, and as a dedicated Uralia Completist you can testify to that. Yes. You've roamed four streets… but what a glorious four streets they were. Quality, not quantity, eh?

vantalu_completist.name: Vantalu Completist
vantalu_completist.statusText: Across the warm, grassy plains, over the foothills and up to the cold caves in the north. This journey has not been a light one, but you survived and completed it just before your new badge hit its expiration date. Not to worry, it just gets a bit stale and moldy.

walking_frozed.name: The Walking Frozed
walking_frozed.statusText: Some say you can't bring frozen matter back to life. You're proving them wrong with every step you take: your brain has been frozen 11 times and flickered back to life every time. You're a medical miracle, a freak of nature: you're The Walking Frozed. Yay!

wanderer.name: Wanderer
wanderer.statusText: Gosh, where HAVEN'T you traveled? Your peregrinations have earned you this footworn-but-carefree Wanderer badge.

wannabe_fly_flycatcher.name: Wannabe Fly Flycatcher
wannabe_fly_flycatcher.desc: Caught 23 perfectly perfect jars of Fireflies
wannabe_fly_flycatcher.statusText: While 23 perfect jars of Fireflies is a fairly decent achievement, it still only earns you the Wannabe Fly Flycatcher badge. Sorry about that.

water_wings.name: Water Wings
water_wings.desc: Doled out waterings to 11 thirsty Bubble Trees
water_wings.statusText: With this, your eleventh Bubble Tree watering, you've earned your Water Wings. Now, fly, little Glitchling! Fly!

wet_william.name: Wet William
wet_william.desc: Meticulously watered 41 gaspingly hot Gas Plants
wet_william.statusText: It takes class to spend time de-hotifying so many Gas Plants. No Wet Willy are you. You have earned the designation of a full-fledged Wet William.

whack_job_deluxe.name: Whack Job Deluxe
whack_job_deluxe.desc: Used a Hatchet to clear 151 dead Trees
whack_job_deluxe.statusText: Some people can't see the forest for the trees. But not you. You just chop 'em down, earning your whack-happy self the title Whack Job Deluxe.

whack_job_extraordinaire.name: Whack Job Extraordinaire
whack_job_extraordinaire.desc: Used a Hatchet to clear 401 dead Trees
whack_job_extraordinaire.statusText: Ashes to ashes. Dust to dust. Trees to planks. It's the cycle of life, and you are the newly anointed Whack Job Extraordinaire who drives that cycle.

whizbang_plantifier.name: Whiz-Bang Plantifier
whizbang_plantifier.statusText: Oh, yeah. Firm yet gentle. That's how you plant a bean. You've earned the title Whiz-Bang Plantifier!

wood_abettor.name: Wood Abettor
wood_abettor.desc: Petted and watered 7 Wood Trees to the full woody bloom of adulthood
wood_abettor.statusText: Say... did you just water and pet 7 Wood trees to maturity?  Bravo! Upon your over-sized melon we bequeath the title of Wood Abettor. Go forth and continue to do your thang.

wood_wacker.name: Wood Wacker
wood_wacker.desc: Used a Hatchet to gently harvest Planks from Wood Trees 17 times
wood_wacker.statusText: You've hacked Planks from Wood Trees 17 times. You know what this makes you? A Wood Wacker. Don't feel badly. This is progress. And the trees don't mind. Much.

workaholist.name: Workaholist
workaholist.desc: Ranked as top 5 contributors for 127 phases of a project
workaholist.statusText: Whoa. You've been a top 5 contributor on, what, 79 phases of a project now? You're like a hooch-aholic, but for work! We hereby dub you a Workaholist.

world_class_traveler.name: World-Class Traveler
world_class_traveler.statusText: You've got a serious case of wanderlove. You've earned World-Class Traveler status!

world_class_tree_surgeon.name: World-class Tree Surgeon
world_class_tree_surgeon.statusText: When you're a World-class Tree Surgeon who has saved 251 trees from certain unpleasantness, you don't need to put on airs with the tree community. You can breeze past with a saintly air, a song in your heart, and the gratitude of 251 trees under your belt.

xalanga_completist.name: Xalanga Completist
xalanga_completist.statusText: BOOM! You have systematically strutted down every street in Xalanga, a dusty region as exotic-sounding as it is sensibly grid-based. And for this - and just because you're awesome - you get a Xalanga Completist Badge.

you_have_papers.name: You Have Papers!
you_have_papers.desc: Having papers — in order, of course! — is required for various citizenshiply things, including for using public transportation.
you_have_papers.statusText: You DO have papers! Well done. Now go ride a subway!

zhambu_completist.name: Zhambu Completist
zhambu_completist.statusText: You've delicately picked your way through every road on the hazardous Ju-Ju-filled plains of Zhambu. They may have taken many things from you, but they couldn't take this: your Zhambu Completist badge. Because you didn't have it yet. (They still can't take it, don't worry).

zombie.name: Zombie
zombie.statusText: Well, for whatever it's worth, you've just won a Zombie badge. Would a warning to be more careful even help at this point?
